articles.title: Heidi Klum turns up the heat on Instagram and proves her style still has no limits
articles.standfirst: The German model continues to dazzle.
articles.summary: The German model continues to dazzle.
articles.body:
Heidi Klum once again became the center of attention after sharing a new photo on Instagram, making it clear that she still knows how to surprise her followers.

A photo that left little to the imagination

Klum appeared outdoors with her hair down and a colorful blanket as part of her look, while wearing only white underwear and leaving her torso completely exposed . The daring ensemble once again reflected the confidence with which the model has always experimented with her image.

The post was accompanied by a simple good morning message.

Heidi Klum also knows how to completely change her mood

Days later, Klum shared another post from Project Runway, this time with a much more elegant look . Sitting in front of the cameras, she wore a shiny black dress, matching heels and her hair down, creating a sophisticated image that was completely different.

The transformation captures one of the defining characteristics that has followed Klum throughout her career: her ability to move between very different styles and adapt to every setting without losing her essence .

A career that has gone far beyond the runway

For decades, the model has established herself as a true fashion icon, thanks to a career shaped by choices that have gone far beyond the trends of the moment.

Klum rose to international fame during the 1990s and became one of the best-known faces of Victoria's Secret . She also appeared on the cover of Sports Illustrated Swimsuit, while building a career that would eventually expand into other areas of entertainment.

Television became an important part of that journey. Project Runway is one of her most notable projects, while Germany's Next Topmodel has allowed her to maintain a constant presence in front of audiences in her home country.

articles.title: BigXthaPlug is arrested ahead of two major concerts as his weekend takes an unexpected turn
articles.standfirst: What happened?
articles.summary: What happened?
articles.body:
BigXthaPlug had a weekend of music and performances ahead of him , with two major shows scheduled within just 24 hours. However, on Friday, August 21 , when he was expected to take the stage at the Country Rising Festival in Winnipeg, Canada , the festival announced that he would not perform.

What was initially described by the festival as a “personal emergency” eventually received a more concrete explanation: Xavier Landum had been arrested that same day by the Allen Police Department and taken to the Collin County Jail in Texas.

Why was BigXthaPlug arrested?

According to records, Landum was arrested on three charges: driving while intoxicated, possession of less than two ounces of marijuana, and unlawful possession of a firearm.

BigXthaPlug regains his freedom

After the uncertainty surrounding his arrest, first over how long he would remain in custody and then over whether he would be able to make his next scheduled appearance, BigXthaPlug was released from jail on bond Saturday morning. Shortly afterward, he confirmed through his social media accounts that he was free .

BigXthaPlug is scheduled to perform this Saturday as the headliner at the Iowa State Fair in Des Moines . The concert will take place at the Grandstand, one of the event's main stages, with XOLEX joining him as a special guest.

articles.title: What really happened? Why Hayden Panettiere's mother thinks her boyfriend is lying to the police
articles.standfirst: Lesley Vogel has raised questions about the timeline surrounding her daughter's final hours, while authorities continue investigating her death
articles.summary: Lesley Vogel has raised questions about the timeline surrounding her daughter's final hours, while authorities continue investigating her death
articles.body:
H ayden Panettiere 's mother, Lesley Vogel , has publicly challenged the account given by Brian Hickerson about the circumstances surrounding the actress's death, arguing that unanswered questions remain about what happened during her final hours.

Panettiere , known for her roles in Heroes and Nashville, died at 36 after she was found unresponsive at an Airbnb in Greenville, South Carolina, on August 16.

Hickerson , her on-and-off boyfriend, was at the property with his brother, Zach Hickerson , according to a police report. Authorities have said there were no initial signs of trauma or foul play, while the investigation remains ongoing.

Vogel's concerns center on the timeline Hickerson reportedly gave police. According to her account of what she learned from an officer at the scene, Hickerson said he had last seen Panettiere doing her makeup before leaving.

He allegedly returned later, went to sleep and was awakened when Zach arrived. The brothers then reportedly discovered Panettiere unresponsive. That version of events has left Vogel unconvinced.

Speaking with the Daily Mail, she questioned how Hickerson could have been sleeping near Panettiere without realizing something was seriously wrong.

She also focused on the presence of Narcan at the property, a medication commonly used to rapidly reverse the effects of an opioid overdose.

Vogel alleged, “I think there will be a discrepancy in the timeline, meaning Brian had to go out and buy the Narcan while he left her there because I do not believe he happened to have two bottles of Narcan on him, like he carried them around in his back pocket.”

She also questioned, “I don’t know how you can take a nap near someone who’s dying and not realize something’s wrong.”

Those are allegations from Panettiere's mother, rather than established findings from investigators. The circumstances surrounding the Narcan have nevertheless become an important part of the public discussion.

Conflicting accounts emerge as investigation continues

Zach Hickerson has offered a different version of what happened. He said he went to the Airbnb after he could not reach either Hayden or Brian and eventually entered the property with Brian .

According to Zach, they discovered Panettiere unconscious, prompting him to call 911 while Brian administered Narcan.

Zach has strongly pushed back against speculation about what happened.

“There are a lot of assumptions, speculations and accusations currently swirling,” Zach told TMZ. He added that the truth would “come out” as authorities complete their investigation.

Brian Hickerson , meanwhile, has not publicly offered a detailed account himself. His attorney, Sloan Ellis , has emphasized that the investigation is still underway and asked that the process be allowed to continue.

The attorney previously stated, “Hayden’s death remains under investigation and it is important to allow that investigation to proceed.”

The case has drawn additional attention because of the complicated history between Panettiere and Hickerson . Their relationship began in 2018 and was marked by serious allegations of domestic violence.

Hickerson was convicted in connection with an assault involving Panettiere and served jail time. Panettiere also discussed the relationship and her struggles with addiction in her memoir, This Is Me: A Reckoning.

Vogel has repeatedly expressed her belief that Hickerson had a damaging influence on her daughter. She previously said, “This person in her life that we have been trying to get rid of for quite some time was with her at her death,” referring directly to Hickerson.

In another statement, she said, “Although my daughter and I were estranged, it was not for lack of care or love. It was due to the involvement of a toxic individual who I believe led to her death.”

Authorities, however, have not publicly concluded that Hickerson caused or contributed to Panettiere's death. A preliminary investigation found no evidence of trauma or foul play, while toxicology and other investigative work are expected to provide more answers.

The Drug Enforcement Administration has also become involved in the investigation, adding another layer to a case that remains unresolved.

For now, Vogel's claims remain allegations and suspicions rather than proven facts. The conflicting accounts surrounding Panettiere's final hours are likely to receive further scrutiny as investigators work to establish exactly what happened inside the South Carolina Airbnb.

Panettiere's death has left her family, friends and fans searching for answers, but the most important questions, including the precise cause and circumstances of her death, remain in the hands of investigators.

articles.title: Ester Expósito surprises everyone in Ibiza alongside Mbappé with a look that completely changes her beach style
articles.summary: The couple, who began their relationship at the start of the year, chose the Mediterranean to continue their vacation. After visiting Sardinia, Ester Expósito and Kylian Mbappé arrived in Ibiza aboard a luxurious catamaran, where they were photographed enjoying the sea and a few days away from their professional commitments.
articles.body:
The couple, who began their relationship at the start of the year, chose the Mediterranean to continue their vacation. After visiting Sardinia, Ester Expósito and Kylian Mbappé arrived in Ibiza aboard a luxurious catamaran, where they were photographed enjoying the sea and a few days away from their professional commitments.

Ibiza once again became the setting of choice for Ester Expósito and Kylian Mbappé. The actress and the soccer player were seen aboard the boat, strolling on the deck, enjoying the scenery, and spending time in the water—a much more relaxed side of themselves than they usually show in front of the cameras.

Summer Continues for the Couple of the Moment

With Ibiza as their latest destination, Expósito and Mbappé have added another joint appearance to a summer marked by their travels around the Mediterranean. Photos of the two during their getaway have once again sparked interest in a relationship that has never been far from the public eye.

In some photos, they’re seen strolling around the boat and enjoying the scenery. In others, they’re in the water, engaging in water activities and making the most of the day away from any public events.

Ester Expósito also turned heads with her look

Beyond Mbappé’s presence, the photos also showcased the actress’s style. Expósito opted for two completely different beach looks during the getaway.

In one of the images, she is seen wearing a white bikini paired with a matching sarong—a simple yet elegant choice. In another, she completely changes things up with an animal-print design, which is much more eye-catching and makes a different visual statement.

The photos from her getaway to the Balearic island once again put the spotlight on the couple, but they also highlight a detail unique to the actress: on the same trip, Ester Expósito went from the simplicity of a white bikini to an animal print that completely elevated her beach look.

articles.title: How did Ester Expósito and Kylian Mbappé meet? The story that may have begun in Real Madrid's locker room
articles.standfirst: The first images of the actress and the footballer together sparked rumors in March, but several later reports suggest that their story began much earlier.
articles.summary: The first images of the actress and the footballer together sparked rumors in March, but several later reports suggest that their story began much earlier.
articles.body:
A picture is worth more than a thousand words; that of Ester and Kylian is worth a million, because there are stories that begin with a photograph, and in this case that was so. Their meeting in Paris was enough for their names to appear together and for the question to begin: When and where did they meet?

The answer, however, seems to be in Madrid. According to different versions published in Spain, the footballer had already taken an interest in the actress and is said to have asked about her within his close circle.

The photographs in the French capital suggested that this was where the story began; however, the chronology published later points in another direction.

According to information gathered by Spanish media, Expósito and Mbappé had already met in Madrid before traveling together to the City of Light. There was even talk of meetings prior to February 25, always under an attempt to maintain the utmost discretion. The reality is that both the actress and the player share the same residential area, and there is suspicion of previous and very discreet meetings.

Who set the story in motion?

One of the details that has generated the most curiosity since the rumors began is who made the first move. Some reports pointed to Mbappé as the one who started asking about her in the locker room.

The name that appears in the middle of that story is Vinícius Jr. 's. The Brazilian forward is a friend of the actress and, at the same time, Mbappé's teammate at Real Madrid . A connection far simpler than it might seem for two people with such exposed lives.

The published version about those first contacts suggests that social media also played an important role. Before meeting face to face, the two already knew each other indirectly.

A dinner, a bowling alley and a key image

In Paris , the first signs began to appear. Both were linked to a dinner and a bowling game, while reports also emerged about them coinciding at a hotel. Along the same lines, what definitively sparked the relationship was when Mbappé headed to the airport, Expósito appeared in the vehicle taking him there.

From that point on, the story stopped being a simple coincidence between two celebrities. Their next moves were followed much more closely.

Months later, the couple was seen together again during their vacation. Sardinia and Ibiza became some of the settings of their summer, and the photographs once again showed that the story that had begun far from the cameras had ended up being impossible to keep completely private.

The truth is that neither Ester nor Kylian has publicly shared exactly how they met. We do not know the exact day they saw each other for the first time, who made the first move, or what that first conversation was like. Nor is there an official version from either of them about when they began seeing each other.

articles.title: Hayden Panettiere reportedly taken out of apartment on a stretcher twice while living with Brian Hickerson
articles.standfirst: The actress’ struggles, relationship history, and ongoing death investigation are drawing renewed focus
articles.summary: The actress’ struggles, relationship history, and ongoing death investigation are drawing renewed focus
articles.body:
H ayden Panettiere ’s final years have come under renewed scrutiny after a neighbor claimed she saw the actress being taken from her Los Angeles apartment on a gurney on two separate occasions while she was in a relationship with Brian Hickerson .

Mia Terrazas , who still lives in the same West Hollywood apartment complex, told Page Six that the incidents occurred in July 2023 and January 2024.

She said she witnessed firefighters removing Panettiere from the building and claimed she noticed what appeared to be injuries on the actress.

Terrazas alleged she saw “bright red spots” and “bruises” on Panettiere and said Hickerson was present during both incidents.

“It appeared that she had been beaten up. It wasn’t apparent to me that it could have been anything else,” Terrazas said.

Panettiere ’s relationship with Hickerson had previously been marked by allegations of abuse, arrests, and legal proceedings.

In 2021, Hickerson pleaded no contest to two felony counts of injuring a spouse or cohabitant after prosecutors filed charges that included allegations of domestic violence.

He was sentenced to jail time, probation, and required to complete domestic violence classes.

Concerns about Panettiere and Hickerson’s relationship

Terrazas said she and her daughter, Vileena Koneru , attempted to raise concerns with firefighters during both gurney incidents. She also claimed she regularly heard arguments coming from Panettiere ’s apartment.

“You can tell somebody’s arguing just by the tonality,” Terrazas said. “It was very hostile.”

The neighbor also alleged she once heard Panettiere shouting at Hickerson in an elevator, saying, “Just leave me alone! Just stop!”

Terrazas said she also contacted authorities after seeing Hickerson at the apartment complex despite a protective order that had been issued following his legal case.

She claimed deputies removed him from the property on at least one occasion but that he later returned.

In August 2025, residents were reportedly warned about Hickerson ’s presence at the building, with notices encouraging them to contact authorities if he was seen in common areas.

Investigation into Panettiere’s death remains ongoing

Panettiere died at age 36 after emergency responders were called to a South Carolina residence earlier this month.

Authorities initially said there were no signs of foul play, while the coroner’s office confirmed that no signs of trauma were discovered that contributed to her death.

Toxicology results are still pending as investigators continue determining the cause and manner of death.

Hickerson has denied any suggestion of foul play through his attorney, saying the investigation should be allowed to continue.

“Hayden’s death remains under investigation, and it is important to allow that investigation to proceed,” Hickerson ’s attorney said. “As has been publicly reported, police confirmed there were no signs of foul play.”

Before her death, Panettiere had spoken publicly about her difficult relationship history, including the struggles she faced while trying to leave abusive situations.

In her memoir, she described feeling trapped in a cycle where former partners would return to her life.

The actress, best known for roles in “Heroes” and “Nashville,” had also openly discussed her battles with addiction and personal challenges.

As authorities await further details from the investigation, questions surrounding Panettiere ’s final years continue to draw attention, with those close to her remembering an actress who faced significant struggles while remaining beloved by fans around the world.

articles.title: What is Cristiano Ronaldo doing in Paris?
articles.standfirst: The Al Nassr forward traveled to the French capital to attend the closing ceremony of the 2026 Esports World Cup, where he is participating as one of the tournament's global ambassadors.
articles.summary: The Al Nassr forward traveled to the French capital to attend the closing ceremony of the 2026 Esports World Cup, where he is participating as one of the tournament's global ambassadors.
articles.body:
"The Bug" made the news again today, although this time far from a football pitch. The Al Nassr forward traveled to Paris this Sunday to attend the closing ceremony of the Esports World Cup 2026.

The organization confirmed the Portuguese footballer's continued participation for this edition alongside chess player Magnus Carlsen, strengthening the connection between traditional sports, video games, and entertainment.

A figure linked to the tournament

The Al-Nassr star was present at the event as one of the tournament's global ambassadors, a figure that brings even more prominence to a competition that has continued to grow in recent years.

His presence gives a tournament that in recent years has sought to expand its reach beyond the usual video game community enormous international exposure.

What is the Esports World Cup?

The organization defines the Esports World Cup as the largest multi-game esports competition in the world. In the current edition, over seven weeks it brings together the best players and international organizations to compete in tournaments across dozens of different titles. Organized by the Esports World Cup Foundation , it distributes more than 70 million dollars in prize money among the various competitions, qualifying tournaments, the MVP awards and the Club Championship.

Its origins date back to Gamers Without Borders, a series of charity tournaments promoted by the Saudi Esports Federation to raise funds during the COVID-19 pandemic.

Cristiano Ronaldo is a global ambassador for the Esports World Cup 2026 , and his presence aims to connect traditional sports with competitive gaming and attract massive audiences worldwide. With more than one billion followers across his social media, he becomes a person with unprecedented visibility.

All Gamers takes the title

The Chinese team All Gamers was crowned winner of the third edition of the Esports World Cup, a gigantic video game tournament that concluded on Sunday in Paris after seven weeks of competition.

All Gamers thus dethroned Saudi Arabia’s Team Falcons , two-time champions, while France’s Vitality completed the podium, just like last year.

The final victory was decided in the racing game Trackmania , from which the Frenchman Gwendal Duparc emerged victorious, earning the title for his club, which also pockets seven million dollars.

With the closing ceremony in Paris , the 2026 edition brought seven weeks of competition to an end. And among the figures who helped turn the event into a phenomenon that transcends video games was Cristiano Ronaldo, whose presence once again demonstrated the reach esports seek to have beyond their traditional audience.

articles.title: She posted the moment on Instagram and ended up arrested: What happened to Meliza Campos-Sanchez?
articles.standfirst: The Florida influencer is arrested and faces charges of first-degree arson, child abuse, and child neglect.
articles.summary: The Florida influencer is arrested and faces charges of first-degree arson, child abuse, and child neglect.
articles.body:
The case has caused shock after authorities found videos on her social media that, according to investigators, would show the mother exposing her two daughters to hot wax and later causing a fire inside the home she shares with the minors.

Meliza Campos Sanches , 26, was arrested in Miami - Dade and faces charges of arson, child abuse, and neglect charges.

Instagram posts change the course of the case

Everything began on August 16 when fire department crews responded to a home because of a fire reported in the kitchen. According to the arrest documents, an investigator determined that the flames had been caused using direct fire, flammable liquids, and combustible materials.

Additionally, investigators discovered two videos posted on the Instagram account of influencer Campos-Sanchez . According to the case file, the images in question documented part of what happened.

In one of the videos, the woman appears handling a lit candle and pouring melted wax first on herself and then on the hands of her daughters, ages 3 and 6 , according to investigators. Another of the videos allegedly shows Campos-Sanchez in the kitchen while she sets fire to clothing placed on the floor.

Investigators later found burned materials, a lighter, and other items they considered relevant to reconstructing the origin of the fire.

The woman appears wearing a silver mask while handling and setting clothing on fire in a scene that matches part of the evidence found at the residence.

Their daughters were also questioned

According to testimony gathered by investigators, the two minors were in the house when the fire broke out.

"The older of the girls told the officers that they were inside the home while their mother was setting clothes on fire in the kitchen. Another relevant detail, is that apparently the younger of the girls had helped put out the fire with water.

"The girls' father stated that he was not at home, since he is temporarily living with his parents due to marital problems. According to his account, he was alerted by the videos and went to the authorities. The girls were placed in the custody of Yusniel Cue .

The Influencer underwent a mental health evaluation.

Following the incident, Meliza was transferred to a mental health hospital before being admitted to prison and was later held at the Turner Guilford Knight Correctional Center. The judge in charge of the case ordered that she remain away from her daughters and directed that mental evaluations continue.

For the moment, she is facing charges and accusations that will have to be resolved within the judicial process, including her immigration status.

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo's uncomfortable gesture after Infantino reminded him of the goals he still needs to make history
articles.standfirst: The Portuguese received unexpected motivation on his path to 1,000 goals, but the cameras ended up focusing on another detail.
articles.summary: The Portuguese received unexpected motivation on his path to 1,000 goals, but the cameras ended up focusing on another detail.
articles.body:
G ianni Infantino reminded the Portuguese star that he is getting closer and closer to 1,000 goals , but a moment captured by the cameras ended up drawing the attention of fans and went viral.

Cristiano Ronaldo has spent decades getting the world of football used to breaking records; currently, he has one pending challenge fueling his ambition: reaching 1,000 official goals in his career.

The Portuguese participated in the closing ceremony of the Esports World Cup 2026, an event that brought together the best teams and players in the world of competitive video games over several weeks.

During the final day of the tournament, held this Sunday, August 23, CR7 met with Gianni Infantino . The FIFA president took advantage of the meeting to talk to him about one of the great goals the forward is still pursuing: to reach 1,000 official goals in his career.

Cristiano has built his career around records and, at 40 years old, he continues trying to add to a list of milestones that seems to have no end, now chasing 1,000 goals after already reaching 977 .

Based on this information, the FIFA president reminded the striker that he only needs 23 goals to reach the historic figure.

However, the moment after this greeting is what ended up drawing attention.

The cameras captured the striker's gesture as he was leaving, and the images quickly began to go viral. The moment was shared by fans, who began to debate the striker's reaction. Without an official explanation for his expression, the scene remained one of those images that quickly spark conversation around a global figure like CR7.

articles.title: Simone Biles puts gymnastics on hold, hits the water in a micro bikini, and her fans are already imagining her winning another Olympic gold
articles.standfirst: The Olympic champion set gymnastics aside for a moment during her vacation, and an activity in the water got her followers imagining her in another sport.
articles.summary: The Olympic champion set gymnastics aside for a moment during her vacation, and an activity in the water got her followers imagining her in another sport.
articles.body:
S imone Biles first surprised on Instagram with some images in which she showed off her days of rest by the sea. The Olympic champion appeared in a micro bikini enjoying the Dominican Republic, far from the gyms and the pressure of competition.

But it was her appearance in the water that ended up sparking an unexpected conversation among her followers. What for Biles seems to be simply an activity during her vacation was, for some fans, enough to imagine her starring in a new sporting adventure.

Simone Biles swaps the gym for the water

The getaway comes days before the start of a new American football season, in which her husband, Jonathan Owens, will begin a new chapter with the Indianapolis Colts after his time with the Chicago Bears.

Meanwhile, Biles took the opportunity to unplug and enjoy a few days by the sea. In one of the images from her visit to the Dominican Republic, the gymnast appears in a micro-bikini while enjoying a day in the water.

The image was very different from the usual ones of Biles on the bars, the beam or the floor. However, her followers noticed one detail: the ease with which the athlete seemed to handle herself in a completely different activity. The queen of gymnastics once again showed why she is considered the best in the world with a backflip from a yacht.

The post also left a question among her followers: could Simone Biles succeed in another discipline?

Fans have already found another sport for her

For now, the reality is much simpler. Biles has not announced any change of discipline nor has she confirmed that she is preparing to compete in a water sport..

Fans' comments appeared quickly. One of the most striking went straight to the point: “Next up, Olympic Gold for diving” , a phrase with which one fan was already imagining the American competing for an Olympic gold in diving.

The idea is not hard to understand. Biles is one of the most successful athletes in Olympic history, and her extraordinary body control, coordination, and power are precisely some of the traits that turned her into a gymnastics legend.

That said, for now it all remains in the realm of her followers' imagination. The American is simply enjoying her vacation and trying a different activity , with no confirmation whatsoever that she wants to trade gymnastics for diving.

And while Biles enjoys a few days of freedom away from competition, her fans have already found her a new impossible challenge: to see her dive into the water and climb back to the top of an Olympic podium.

articles.title: Sydney Sweeney challenges Tom Cruise with a madness in the air
articles.standfirst: Warning: The images are not suitable for those who are afraid of heights.
articles.summary: Warning: The images are not suitable for those who are afraid of heights.
articles.body:
'The star of "Euphoria" surprised her followers when she posted the shocking video this Monday morning. She immediately took aim at Hollywood's most famous stunt specialist... “Watch out, Tom Cruise”'

The actress launched herself into a risky discipline, climbing onto the wing of an airplane in mid-flight as part of a spectacular wing walking session.

Face down hundreds of meters above the ground

Sweeney starred in a risky performance in which the participants performed on the exterior of an aircraft while it carried out different maneuvers.

The actress appears perfectly equipped, with goggles and a safety vest, while remaining attached to the airplane. Everything seems relatively under control until the aircraft begins to spin and make different movements.

In a matter of seconds, the actress ends up face down while the plane continues flying. A scene that could have come straight out of an action movie.

What ended up giving the matter a touch of challenge was the message that accompanied the post: “Watch out Tom Cruise” . A clear friendly provocation aimed at the actor, famous for pushing his own action scenes to the limit.

The reference makes sense: the scene recalls the spectacular wing-walking that Cruise starred in in Mission: Impossible – The Final Reckoning , where he performed a sequence on a biplane during aerial maneuvers.

Thus, Sweeney not only got on a plane to live an extreme experience. She also made it clear that, at least for now , Tom Cruise has a new rival in Hollywood when it comes to doing crazy things in the air.

articles.title: “He was pressuring her”: Sources claim Hayden Panettiere’s ex-convict boyfriend demanded to have a baby to cement relationship before her death
articles.standfirst: Friends were worried as actress considered whether she could face another pregnancy after severe postpartum depression
articles.summary: Friends were worried as actress considered whether she could face another pregnancy after severe postpartum depression
articles.body:
In the months before Hayden Panettiere ’s sudden death, the actress was allegedly facing pressure from boyfriend Brian Hickerson to have another child, despite her previous struggle with severe postpartum depression after becoming a mother.

Sources cited by Hollywood insider Rob Shuter claim Hickerson , 37, was actively pushing the idea of starting a family with Panettiere, rather than casually discussing it as a distant possibility.

“Brian wasn’t casually talking about someday becoming a father, he was pushing Hayden to have a baby with him,” one source claimed.

“She understood exactly what another pregnancy could potentially mean for her emotionally, and she wasn’t convinced it was something she wanted to risk.”

Friends worried about another pregnancy

Those close to the couple allegedly had concerns that went beyond Panettiere ’s health history. One insider claimed Hickerson ’s financial situation also caused unease among friends.

“Brian was struggling financially, so people absolutely questioned his motives,” the source said. “A baby wouldn’t just make them parents, it would connect him to Hayden for the rest of his life. That raised alarm bells.”

Another source said Panettiere viewed the decision through the lens of what she had already endured after the birth of her daughter, Kaya, whom she shares with former fiance Wladimir Klitschko .

“Hayden knew how badly things had gone after Kaya,” the insider said. “She had lived through postpartum depression, addiction, and the heartbreak of being separated from her daughter. Brian wanted a baby.

“Hayden understood the possible consequences. That was the tension between them.”

Panettiere had spoken publicly about the emotional toll of being separated from Kaya , who has lived with Klitschko in Ukraine since 2018.

Panettiere was planning to visit Kaya

The actress’ relationship with her daughter remained central to her life before her death, according to close friend and hairstylist Erick Orellana .

“She was talking about how she wanted to take a vacation, and that she wanted to go and see her daughter,” Orellana said. “Her daughter was always her absolute priority. She loved her so much.”

He added: “Her daughter was the absolute light of her life. She lit up when she spoke about her. Everything she did revolved around her.”

Panettiere , 36, was found unresponsive in Greenville, South Carolina, on August 16 after emergency responders were called to a report of a woman in cardiac arrest.

Her cause and manner of death hadn't been publicly determined in the material provided. That distinction remains important as new allegations about the actress’ private life continue to surface.

articles.title: Olivia Dunne and Olivia Ponton recreate Pamela Anderson’s iconic ‘Baywatch’ run
articles.summary: Olivia Dunne and Olivia Ponton just tried to recreate one of the most recognizable runs in television history, and apparently there's a technique to getting it right.
articles.body:
Olivia Dunne and Olivia Ponton just tried to recreate one of the most recognizable runs in television history, and apparently there's a technique to getting it right.

The two took on the famous “Baywatch” slow-motion run made iconic by Pamela Anderson, with Dunne giving Ponton some pointers before they put their own version to the test. Then it was time to run.

With the beach as their backdrop, Dunne and Ponton went full “Baywatch,” running toward the camera in slow motion before laughing off their attempt.

Pamela Anderson turned the run into a pop-culture phenomenon decades ago.

Now Dunne and Ponton are finding out that making slow motion look effortless might actually require a little practice.

articles.title: Melania Trump’s low profile sparks fresh debate over the role of first lady
articles.standfirst: There are ongoing reports about tensions within Donald Trump’s inner circle
articles.summary: There are ongoing reports about tensions within Donald Trump’s inner circle
articles.body:
Questions about Melania Trump’s role in the White House have resurfaced after author Michael Wolff claimed that the First Lady has not spent a single night at the White House during President Donald Trump’s second term, fueling renewed speculation about her unusually limited public presence.

Wolff, who has written several books about Trump and his inner circle, made the comments during an appearance on The Daily Beast podcast. According to the author, Melania has been largely absent from the White House since Trump returned to office in January 2025, appearing only occasionally at official events and public functions.

“Her official job, the official part of being a first lady to do good works, she has converted into private enterprise for herself,” Wolff said. The claims come after Melania made her first public appearance at the White House in roughly a month, a return that drew attention not only because of her absence but also because of ongoing reports about tensions within Trump’s inner circle.

Melania has privately expressed frustration over Harp’s influence

Wolff alleged that Melania has been uncomfortable with the prominent role played by Natalie Harp, a longtime Trump aide often described as one of the president’s closest advisers. Harp has become a constant presence around Trump, frequently accompanying him during public appearances and daily activities.

According to Wolff, Melania has privately expressed frustration over Harp’s influence and has preferred not to be at the White House when Harp is present. The author compared the situation to Trump’s first administration, when former White House Communications Director Hope Hicks was frequently seen around the president. Wolff argued that Trump has long created what he described as an awkward dynamic between Melania and the women who occupy influential positions in his orbit.

The debate surrounding Melania’s role has also extended beyond personal relationships and into the structure of the White House itself. Historians have noted that the East Wing traditionally serves as the operational center for a first lady’s initiatives, charitable projects, and public outreach efforts.

Staffing levels have become another point of comparison

Katherine A.S. Sibley, a history professor at Saint Joseph’s University, told The Guardian that recent changes to the White House and the diminished visibility of the East Wing symbolize a broader shift in how the role of first lady is being treated.

Staffing levels have become another point of comparison. While recent first ladies typically maintained teams of roughly 20 staff members to oversee policy initiatives, public engagements, and charitable programs, reports indicate that Melania’s office currently operates with only five staffers.

The First Lady’s business ventures have also attracted attention. Unlike many presidential spouses who wait until after leaving Washington to publish memoirs or pursue media projects, Melania launched a book and participated in a documentary project during her husband’s presidency. Reports have indicated that Amazon paid approximately $40 million for the documentary, with a substantial portion of that revenue reportedly going directly to Melania.

Amazon is also developing a television series centered on the First Lady.

For critics, those ventures reinforce the perception that Melania has focused more on private opportunities than on the traditional responsibilities associated with the position. Wolff dismissed the documentary as “empty content,” arguing that it revealed little about her personal life or public mission.

articles.title: Bill Gates and his latest global concern: "What do humans and cows have in common?"
articles.standfirst: The founder of Microsoft reflects on mosquitoes on his website
articles.summary: The founder of Microsoft reflects on mosquitoes on his website
articles.body:
Bill Gates , founder of Microsoft and philanthropist, has laid out his latest concern on a global scale. "What do humans and cows have in common?" , he asked on his website. The problem for both, according to the billionaire, is insects , to which he has devoted a reflection on their impact on the planet. As for cows, Bill Gates explained that the screwworm fly is a major threat. Regarding humans, the magnate has insisted at length on mosquitoes .

'Bill Gates: "There are many reasons to hate mosquitoes, but malaria tops the list"'

'The founder of Microsoft has lamented the severe impact mosquitoes have on global health. "There are many reasons to hate mosquitoes, but malaria tops the list" , he commented. Bill Gates has explained that this disease claims 600,000 lives each year, something that can be reduced, he noted, through investment and collaboration among countries. '

Gates has pointed out some of the measures to curb mosquitoes: installing dual-active-ingredient mosquito nets (with two insecticides to overcome mosquito resistance), electric insecticide diffusers , and finally, targeting these insects at the population level . "In 1954, scientists sterilized the males using radiation. They released the sterilized insects into the affected area and, since they could not reproduce, the population disappeared. That was how the screwworm fly was eliminated for the first time," he recalled.

'Bill Gates: "The idea is simple: a mosquito that cannot transmit malaria"'

Bill Gates has defended targeting mosquitoes at the population level to prevent them from carrying diseases. "The idea is simple: a mosquito that cannot transmit malaria," he summarized. The founder of Microsoft stated that scientists in Tanzania have managed to ensure that the species of mosquito that transmits malaria in Africa does not develop the parasite inside it, so that it cannot transmit it: " The mosquitoes would keep flying and fulfilling their role, but they would not be able to transmit malaria . Each time they mated with another mosquito, they would pass on the gene that protects them from the parasite".

Bill Gates has lamented that, in his opinion, collaboration among countries is not adequate to completely eradicate malaria. "Donor governments are cutting health aid," he lamented. His Foundation, he said, is trying to contribute so that the impact of this divestment is smaller. "I continue to advocate for an increase in funding , because it is absurd to put the health of the world's children at risk when we know how to protect them (...). I believe we can eradicate malaria forever . The question is whether the world will decide to make this happen," he concluded.

"I continue to advocate for an increase in funding , because it is absurd to put the health of the world's children at risk when we know how to protect them (...). I believe we can eradicate malaria forever . The question is whether the world will decide to make this happen," he concluded.

articles.title: Jordan Pruitt accuses Miley Cyrus of bullying during her Disney era: "She was relentless"
articles.standfirst: Actress Jordan Pruitt publicly calls out the singer over her alleged comments
articles.summary: Actress Jordan Pruitt publicly calls out the singer over her alleged comments
articles.body:
Actress Jordan Pruitt allegedly suffered bullying at the hands of singer Miley Cyrus while working at Disney Channel . It all started with a post on Reddit featuring a video in which Miley Cyrus mocked Demi Lovato and Selena Gómez . Jordan Pruitt 's response sparked a huge wave of curiosity: "That's how Miley treated everyone back then, including me" . Many users asked for more details about these accusations, and the actress did not hesitate to provide them.

"Miley Cyrus used to call me and leave me disgusting voicemail messages with her friend Mandy saying that I needed a nose job, new teeth, and a choreographer . She was relentless," Jordan Pruitt wrote in her second response. Her words have caused a huge stir on social media, and outlets such as Page Six have tried to contact Miley Cyrus 's representative to get some reaction to her accusations, without success so far.

Jordan Pruitt: "You’re Not Going to Steal My Boyfriend"

Jordan Pruitt's relationship with Miley Cyrus does not seem exactly idyllic, in light of these comments and past statements. The actress already revealed at the beginning of the year that she wrote her song "Boyfriend" , in 2008 , about the former Hannah Montana . "You're not going to steal my boyfriend, no way" , can be heard in her song. Social media did not take long to speculate, since both had a relationship with fellow artist Nick Jonas . Miley dated him first and later he was in a relationship with Jordan Pruitt .

American Jordan Pruitt , who is currently 35 years old , is married and has a son, began her artistic career very early, at the age of 13. One of her biggest musical hits is "Outside Looking In" . Her time at Disney catapulted her professional career, although she publicly accused her manager of sexual harassment in August 2019.

articles.title: Karol G surprises with pink micro shorts and shows off a new era that keeps making headlines
articles.standfirst: The Colombian singer shared a post that captures the bold and personal moment surrounding the release of her new album.
articles.summary: The Colombian singer shared a post that captures the bold and personal moment surrounding the release of her new album.
articles.body:
Without a doubt, Karol G knows how to turn heads, and although she does not often share many photos on Instagram , every time she posts something new, she manages to melt her fans. This time was no exception, as her latest post once again caused a stir among her followers.

Karol G takes fluorescent pink to the limit

The first outfit was the most eye-catching of the post. Karol G chose fitted fluorescent pink micro shorts and a matching cropped top , both featuring white lettering that slightly broke up the intense color of the pieces.

Black boots with white laces added even more edge to the combination. With her hair worn down and the photo taken in front of a mirror, the outfit highlighted the singer's sensual and daring side while maintaining the distinctive style that often defines her looks .

The singer swaps pink for a completely different look

Another photo took the post in a completely different direction. Karol G appeared in black shorts, a cropped black jacket and matching boots , paired with white socks that stood out against the rest of the outfit.

The detail that gave the look even more personality was a small crown, while her loose hair added a more carefree touch.

But there was something else hidden in this second appearance. The singer was also wearing a shirt covered in glittering letters that spelled out the name of her new album , turning the outfit into a direct reference to the new musical era she has just begun.

And that is where the post became about more than just fashion.

Karol G celebrates the moment she is experiencing with her new album

The photos come after the release of No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto , Karol G's sixth studio album, which arrived on August 7, 2026.

The project shows a more personal side of the singer and is primarily centered around heartbreak, exploring different emotions that emerge after a breakup and the feelings that come with those experiences. That sensitivity has also been reflected in the way Karol G has accompanied this new era, using her social media to share different moments connected to the album.

Karol G's success is also reflected on the charts

The album's response has gone beyond social media and her posts. No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto debuted at No. 1 on Billboard's Top Latin Albums, confirming the impact of its release .

In addition, Karol G placed 13 songs on Hot Latin Songs at the same time, highlighting the reach the project achieved during its first few days.

articles.title: Dolly Parton didn't leave this world as some fragile lady she left as a rockstar in heels and leather
articles.standfirst: One unforgettable performance with Miley Cyrus captures Dolly exactly as many fans will want to remember her
articles.summary: One unforgettable performance with Miley Cyrus captures Dolly exactly as many fans will want to remember her
articles.body:
There will be countless photographs and songs used to remember Dolly Parton after her death at 80 , but one performance with Miley Cyrus captures something an obituary never could.

Dressed in towering heels and a black-and-leopard outfit with leather details, Parton stood beside her goddaughter and belted out "I Love Rock 'n' Roll." She was 76 at the time , but the woman on that stage wasn't interested in looking back or slowing down. Dolly moved with the music, traded verses with Cyrus and fed off a crowd singing right along with them.

The performance came during NBC's Miley's New Year's Eve Party in Miami on Dec. 31, 2022, only weeks after Parton had been inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame. She had initially resisted the honor because she didn't consider herself a rock artist . Eventually, she embraced it completely. "I'm a rock star now!" she declared after her induction.

Dolly Parton once imagined dying while doing what she loved

Parton had spoken about death long before it became something her fans wanted to contemplate. In a 2004 interview, while insisting she had no plans to retire, she imagined continuing to perform into extreme old age and even dying while singing a great song or doing something spectacular.

If it happened that way, she suggested, people could at least know she had gone out happy, doing what she loved.

That determination remained with her remarkably close to the end. In what became one of her final interviews, Parton acknowledged the health problems she had faced after spending so much time caring for her husband, Carl Dean, before his death in 2025 . Yet her attention remained on the future. There were still, she said, "so many things I want to achieve."

Miley Cyrus was much more than another singer sharing Dolly's stage

That makes the presence of Cyrus in this particular performance even more meaningful. Dolly was her godmother, but their relationship went far beyond a title. Parton appeared alongside a young Cyrus on Hannah Montana , playing Aunt Dolly, and watched her grow from a Disney star into one of the biggest artists in the world.

In another touching moment between them, Parton told Cyrus "from the bottom of my heart" how proud she had always been of her. But then Dolly turned the compliment around.

She thanked her goddaughter for helping her own career, explaining that appearing with Cyrus during the Hannah Montana years had introduced Dolly to "a whole new set of fans" a younger generation that might otherwise never have discovered her music.

It was an unusually humble admission from a woman who was already a country music legend long before Cyrus was born. Dolly helped guide Miley, but as Dolly herself recognized, Miley eventually helped carry her into another generation.

Years later, there they were together again: godmother and goddaughter, dressed like rockstars, singing "I Love Rock 'n' Roll" while an entire crowd sang with them.

Perhaps that is why the footage feels so powerful now. It doesn't show Dolly Parton as a fragile woman approaching the end of an extraordinary life.

It shows her exactly where she always seemed to belong: in heels and leather, smiling beneath the lights, singing beside someone she loved and looking every bit like the rockstar she had finally allowed herself to become.

articles.title: $81 billion fortune, one growing estate: Julia Koch’s latest Hamptons move
articles.standfirst: The purchase is said to be part of a broader effort to create a long-term family retreat for her three children
articles.summary: The purchase is said to be part of a broader effort to create a long-term family retreat for her three children
articles.body:
B illionaire philanthropist Julia Koch is reportedly expanding her presence in one of the most exclusive real estate markets in the United States, adding another multimillion-dollar property to what has been described as a growing family compound in Southampton, New York.

According to a recent report from Page Six, Koch's latest acquisition is a $33.5 million plot located near her existing holdings on Meadow Lane, the ultra-wealthy oceanfront stretch often referred to as " Billionaire Lane." The purchase is said to be part of a broader effort to create a long-term family retreat for her three children.

The expansion further strengthens Koch's already significant real estate portfolio in the Hamptons. Her Southampton holdings currently include two properties on Meadow Lane. One is an $18 million mansion, while the other is a sprawling estate she purchased in 2022 for approximately $75 million.

Restoration efforts remain in the early planning stages

That larger property has drawn particular attention because of its scale and potential. Described as a 22,000-square-foot Tudor-style home with 15 bedrooms and roughly 500 feet of beachfront, the estate has reportedly required extensive renovation work. Sources familiar with the project told the New York Post that the goal is to modernize the property while preserving its status as one of the premier residences along the East Coast.

A neighboring property owner told the outlet that the estate had fallen into disrepair before Koch acquired it. According to the report, restoration efforts remain in the early planning stages, and a complete transformation could take years to complete.

The Hamptons purchase represents only a small fraction of Koch's vast wealth. With an estimated net worth of $81.2 billion, she ranks as the second-richest woman in the United States. Her fortune stems largely from her late husband David Koch's stake in Koch Industries , one of the largest privately held companies in the world.

Her influence extends well beyond finance

Since David Koch's death in 2019, Julia Koc h has maintained a relatively low public profile despite overseeing one of America's largest fortunes. Unlike many billionaires who frequently appear at high-profile events, Koch has made only limited appearances on New York's social circuit in recent years.

Her influence, however, extends well beyond finance and philanthropy. Koch has developed a reputation for investing heavily in architecture, preservation, and design. Previous projects have included a reported $40 million Upper East Side townhouse , where she enlisted acclaimed designer Peter Marino to oversee renovations. She was also recognized with the Ballinger Award in 2008 for restoration work connected to a Palm Beach property.

The latest Hamptons acquisition reflects a growing trend among ultra-wealthy Americans who are assembling large multi-property estates designed to accommodate future generations. Many billionaires are purchasing neighboring lots and homes to create private compounds that offer security, flexibility, and long-term family planning.

articles.title: Dua Lipa finally reveals how she celebrated her 31st birthday after days of anticipation
articles.standfirst: The singer had teased her birthday with a look that caught everyone's attention, but it was not until two days later that she showed how she enjoyed the celebration.
articles.summary: The singer had teased her birthday with a look that caught everyone's attention, but it was not until two days later that she showed how she enjoyed the celebration.
articles.body:
Dua Lipa knows exactly how to keep her fans waiting. On August 21, the singer shared a pre-birthday post in which she appeared in a long, fitted black dress , sparking all kinds of reactions from her followers, who were eager to discover how she was going to celebrate her 31st birthday. However, the wait lasted a little longer than usual, as the singer did not reveal photos from her celebration until August 24 .

Dua Lipa's birthday weekend

The singer revealed that her birthday weekend included several different moments and looks. One of the first details to catch attention was a new outfit that had nothing to do with the long dress she had previously shown .

In the celebration photos, Dua appeared in a short black dress with a subtle touch of transparency .

But that was not the only style change during the weekend. For a day out, the singer opted for a white top, a black piece on the bottom, a red scarf and her hair pulled back , completing the look with a red bag.

Where did Dua Lipa celebrate her 31st birthday?

Part of the weekend took place at Art Omi, a sculpture park in Ghent, New York, where Dua and Callum Turne r enjoyed a sunny day.

The couple is temporarily in New York due to their respective professional commitments. Turner has filming projects in the city, while Dua has been connected to New York's music scene and has been spotted entering Electric Lady Studios, where she is working on new music.

Is Dua Lipa a big fan of sweets?

Beyond the looks and outings, there is no doubt that Dua Lipa seems to be a big fan of sweet treats. The post also included cakes, desserts and ice cream, offering a glimpse at some of the details that were part of her birthday celebration .

One of the cakes that caught the most attention was a white one decorated with pink and purple flowers, along with the message “Happy Birthday Beba.” The same post also featured another brown cake with an appearance reminiscent of chocolate.

The variety of treats became another detail that made the photos feel like a glimpse into different moments of Dua's birthday weekend rather than just a single celebration.

articles.title: Diddy picked a $100 million fight with NBC now he's paying the price from behind bars
articles.standfirst: The music mogul believed he had a $100 million case against NBC, but from behind bars the legal battle now looks very different
articles.summary: The music mogul believed he had a $100 million case against NBC, but from behind bars the legal battle now looks very different
articles.body:
S ean “Diddy” Combs was the one who decided to take the fight to NBCUniversal. He wasn't asking for an apology or a small settlement. The music mogul went after the media giant for at least $100 million , accusing the companies behind Diddy: The Making of a Bad Boy of damaging his reputation with claims he considered false and reckless.

At the time, it was an aggressive legal move from a man who had spent decades building an enormous entertainment empire and wasn't afraid to go head-to-head with one of the biggest media companies in the world. But the lawsuit didn't deliver the victory Combs was seeking. It was dismissed, and now the case could end with money moving in exactly the opposite direction.

NBCUniversal, Peacock and Ample Entertainment are seeking $990,292 in attorneys' fees from Diddy. They originally requested $927,448 and later added another $62,844 for the additional legal work involved in responding to Combs' challenge to the fees. The nearly $1 million bill has not yet been finalized by the judge, but it creates a brutal reversal for a lawsuit that began with Combs demanding nine figures.

Diddy's fight against NBC has completely flipped

The timing makes that reversal even more striking. Combs is no longer fighting this battle from the same position he occupied when his empire was at its peak. He is now serving a 50-month federal prison sentence after being convicted on two counts of transportation to engage in prostitution, while simultaneously dealing with other lawsuits and continuing efforts to appeal his conviction.

And there is another uncomfortable detail: Combs is reportedly not arguing that NBC and the other defendants have no right to recover attorneys' fees. His fight is now largely over how much they should receive. His attorneys have challenged the size of the bill, including the number of hours and level of lawyers NBCUniversal used to defend itself.

Nothing guarantees that Diddy will ultimately be ordered to pay the entire $990,292 being requested. But the irony is difficult to miss. He started the lawsuit seeking at least $100 million from NBC. He lost it. And now, while sitting in federal prison, the same legal fight he hoped would bring him a massive payday could leave him responsible for a bill approaching $1 million instead.

articles.title: The Anaya Bangar case reopens the controversy: What place do trans women have in women's competitions?
articles.standfirst: The story of the Indian cricketer once again brings to the table a debate that has been dividing the world of sports for years
articles.summary: The story of the Indian cricketer once again brings to the table a debate that has been dividing the world of sports for years
articles.body:
What place trans women have in official women's competitive sports is a discussion that, although it may seem retrograde, is very contemporary.

In this article we will tell the story of Anaya Bangar , the Indian player who found in Australia a chance to resume a career that seemed to have been left behind after her transition.

Bangar will be able to compete in Australian community women's cricket and, starting in March 2027, aspire to the elite level if she meets the conditions established by Cricket Australia. The decision does not mean that she is guaranteed a place on a professional team, but it does mean that she will have a pathway to try to return to competition.

An opportunity that does not guarantee a place in the elite

The case drew attention because it comes at a time when sports federations are making very different decisions about the participation of trans athletes. Cricket is a good example of that divide.

The decision does not mean that Bangar is guaranteed a professional contract or a place in the Women"s Big Bash League (WBBL). What Cricket Australia is granting her is a pathway to try to reach that level and compete for a place on a team.

Australia considers that Bangar can compete under certain conditions. International cricket, by contrast, adopted a much more restrictive stance for its elite women's competitions . That difference is precisely what makes the case something far bigger than the personal story of one player.

To reach elite Australian women’s cricket, Bangar will have to meet the eligibility requirements established by Cricket Australia. Among them is maintaining her testosterone concentration within the set limit for the required period.

And there appears one of the points that generates the most discussion: authorization is not automatic, nor does it mean that she can jump directly to the top category. First she will have to compete, prove her level, and meet the required conditions

The dream of playing again

For Bangar, behind all the controversy there is something much more personal. The player came to think that she would never compete again, and now she has the chance to return to the field.

Her first goal will be to play community cricket and regain her form. Then the bigger challenge will come: if she maintains her eligibility, she will be able to try to reach elite cricket starting in March 2027.

There is no guaranteed contract, no reserved spot, no promise of playing in the WBBL . Just an opportunity.

And that is precisely the point that could keep this discussion open for a long time: while for Bangar it means the possibility of recovering a part of her career, for others it once again raises an uncomfortable question that sport has still not managed to answer definitively: How should women's categories be defined in an era in which inclusion rules are changing?

articles.title: The important decision by Antonela Roccuzzo that changed her life and that she even recommends to her parents
articles.standfirst: Lionel Messi's wife shared how she changed her routine and her body by incorporating a practice that for years she avoided because of a particular fear and that today she even recommends to her parents.
articles.summary: Lionel Messi's wife shared how she changed her routine and her body by incorporating a practice that for years she avoided because of a particular fear and that today she even recommends to her parents.
articles.body:
Antonela Roccuzzo has been showing parts of her training routine on social media for years, but behind that discipline there was a decision that completely changed the way she exercises.

At 38, after seeing the benefits of the activity, the woman from Rosario said that she incorporated a practice she used to prefer to avoid and that she now considers essential.

The practice that at first made her doubt

“Strength exercises were not always part of Antonela’s routine. Over time, however, she changed her mind: today she believes that weights are essential and even recommends to her parents that they incorporate this type of training at least twice a week.”

The Argentine woman explained that she is currently trying to train every day and that she combines different activities to take care of both her physical condition and her mental well-being.

In the interview given to ELLE, the influencer highlights that her current routine is based on healthy eating and daily exercise, combining cardio with some strength-training days.

Currently she practices and is a leading figure in FitJam , a cardiovascular fitness discipline that combines dance, music, choreography, and high-intensity aerobic exercises. This modality focuses on endurance, coordination, and mental disconnection through continuous movement.

In an interview with ELLE Magazine, Antonela stated that she uses this activity mainly as a "therapy" to have fun, relieve stress, and start the day with energy. On the rest of the days of the week, she completes her daily routine with weightlifting and strength training.

The Argentine star's wife said that at first she tried to avoid this type of training, since she didn't want to get too "big" . Nowadays, strength training has become a fundamental part of her workout: she does it twice a week, as part of a routine in which she trains, in total, one hour a day.

“Before, I was afraid of lifting weights because I thought I was going to get ‘big,’ but that never happened. Everyone should lift weights at least one hour a day because it is very important for the future. I always tell my mom and dad: ‘Please, do a little weight training, even if it’s only twice a week

The habits the Messi family maintains

Another vital factor in Antonela Roccuzzo's routine is nutrition. The Argentine model said that she tries to make healthy options and organic products prevail in her family. She also pointed out that, together with Messi, they do not drink alcohol or smoke and try to consume 100% natural organic products since her husband always has to be on a diet because of his profession. "We have to eat healthy," she expressed

Thus, at 38 years old, Antonela Roccuzzo combines a frequent training routine with healthy habits that are part of her daily life . “Everything goes together: exercise, nutrition, and mental health. It’s a way of living” , she concluded.

articles.title: Bill Gates’ ‘doomsday’ AI warning paints a dark future for Earth and humanity
articles.standfirst: Microsoft's founder distinguishes current problems from a much more extreme scenario: an artificial intelligence capable of surpassing human abilities and developing goals that its creators cannot control.
articles.summary: Microsoft's founder distinguishes current problems from a much more extreme scenario: an artificial intelligence capable of surpassing human abilities and developing goals that its creators cannot control.
articles.body:
B ill Gates , one of the entrepreneurs who has most defended the potential of Technology, changed the tone of his speech about AI.

He issued a stark warning indicating that an apocalyptic AI scenario is approaching, with bioterrorism pandemics and enormous job losses, but tech leaders remain silent about it. In a lengthy essay published this week, Gates argued that artificial intelligence could become a tool capable of radically improving humanity’s life.

“AI will either be the greatest equalizer ever invented, or the worst source of injustice”

Throughout the analysis, he warned that in his view, even in the best-case scenario, the transition toward a new stage will be “one of the most turbulent moments in human history.”

He warned forcefully about the global terror that artificial intelligence can generate and that could unfold soon. This is a scenario that the heads of technology companies are intentionally hiding from the public. Additionally, he indicated that AI continues to develop at an " uncontrollable" pace, and that this has surpassed all available warning signs.

The AI will either be the greatest leveler ever invented, or the worst source of injustice," Mr. Gates said. "Even under the best circumstances, the transition to this new era of AI will be one of the most turbulent moments in human history.

Experts and communities are not prepared for the speed at which artificial intelligence is advancing.

The text is titled “The turbulent AI era is here. The choices we make now are critical” (“The turbulent era of AI is here. The choices we make now are critical”). There, Gates writes directly that the world is not adequately preparing for the transition to AI and that there is no plan to facilitate it.

He spoke of a risk to global security since artificial intelligence can gather information for acts of war such as creating bombs, biological weapons, malware, etc., and it is increasingly more capable of acting on that information by itself.

There are hostile actors who could stand to benefit from this power, and they could become an even greater threat-

"Although AI will lead to life-saving advances in medicines and vaccines, it will also make it easier to design a new deadly disease," he said. "Again, the positive capabilities are difficult to separate from the dangerous ones. This is a global problem."

The risks I just mentioned have to do with how AI will empower malicious actors who currently have relatively little power. The same tools will also concentrate power in places where it already exists.

The risk of a new inequality

Gates' fear goes beyond the possibility that millions of people could lose their jobs.

If the companies that control the most advanced technologies accumulate an ever greater amount of power and wealth, AI could widen the gap between those who have access to its benefits and those who are displaced by it.

“How will we use this technology to make the world fairer and prevent the gap between rich and poor from widening?”, Gates poses in his essay.

That is why he proposes discussing new public policies, from national and international institutions specialized in AI to changes in tax systems and measures to fund job training and social safety nets. He also calls for greater international cooperation to address risks that transcend borders.

articles.title: Farewell to the voice of Optimus Prime: Peter Cullen died at 85
articles.standfirst: The legendary voice actor who for more than four decades brought Optimus Prime, the leader of the Transformers' Autobots, to life, died on Wednesday, August 26, at his home in Los Angeles.
articles.summary: The legendary voice actor who for more than four decades brought Optimus Prime, the leader of the Transformers' Autobots, to life, died on Wednesday, August 26, at his home in Los Angeles.
articles.body:
P eter Cullen , the voice that made O ptimus Prime one of the most recognizable characters in the world of cinema, died on Wednesday, August 26 at his home in Los Angeles. He was 85 years old.

The news was confirmed by his agent, Kevin Motley . For more than four decades, Cullen was linked to the leader of the Autobots, from the original Transformers animated series in 1984 to his final appearance as Optimus in Transformers: Rise of the Beasts , released in 2023.

The personal story that shaped Optimus Prime's voice

Cullen made the voice of Optimus Prime one of the most recognizable in pop culture. He first portrayed the character in the original 1984 Transformers animated series and reprised the role in multiple films, series, and video games over the decades, including the live-action movies that began in 2007. His last appearance as Optimus was in Transformers: Rise of the Beasts, in 2023.

But the actor did not limit himself to lending his voice to the Transformers character; he was much more than Optimus Prime. He performed the voice of Eeyore (Ígor) in Winnie the Pooh, and also portrayed K.A.R.R. in Knight Rider as well as in other film and television projects. He even created the unsettling sounds of the Predator in the 1987 film starring Arnold Schwarzenegger.

One of the most moving details of his legacy lies precisely behind Optimus Prime. To build the voice of the Autobot leader, Cullen was inspired by his brother Larry, a Vietnam veteran. He wanted Optimus to convey authority and strength, but also humanity, compassion, and serenity.

The family reported that Cullen died peacefully, surrounded by his loved ones. The cause of death was not disclosed. In his farewell message, he asked that his legacy be remembered with compassion, integrity, and loyalty, and with a phrase that perfectly sums up the character he turned into a legend: “be strong enough to be gentle".

articles.title: Harry and Meghan face a multimillion-dollar bill for their California mansion after returning to the United Kingdom
articles.standfirst: The couple returned to the United Kingdom with their children, but they have no plans to sell their mansion in Montecito for now. Maintaining the property could cost them more than US$600,000 a year.
articles.summary: The couple returned to the United Kingdom with their children, but they have no plans to sell their mansion in Montecito for now. Maintaining the property could cost them more than US$600,000 a year.
articles.body:
The Sussex es returned to the United Kingdom , and it does not mean, at least for now, that they have closed their chapter in California . They are keeping the luxurious mansion in Montecito that they bought in 2020, a decision that means continuing to face a considerable annual bill.

The property, which became the couple's home after their departure from the front line of the British royal family, is worth millions of dollars. Beyond its purchase price, maintaining it means facing the mortgage, taxes, and other expenses related to a property of this caliber every year.

How much does it cost to maintain Harry and Meghan's mansion in Montecito?

Shortly after stepping down from their roles as active members of the royal family, Harry and Meghan purchased the property in question through their company Rockbridge LLC for $14.65 million.

As we said earlier, the value of the property does not end with the purchase price. According to what was cited in The Thimes, the mortgage represents approximately $450,792 per year, while property taxes reached about $149,668 in 2025. Together, both items bring the annual expense to more than $ 600,000, not counting other costs such as maintenance, insurance, or staff.

In other words, the British couple could be spending more than half a million dollars annually simply to keep the property, before adding the rest of the expenses involved in maintaining a mansion of this size.

The return to the United Kingdom could add another multimillion-dollar property

The couple's expenses could increase even further if Harry and Megan decide to settle again in the United Kingdom. Both returned to Great Britain with their children, Archie and Lilibet, who would begin their studies there in September.

"If everything goes according to speculation, the location chosen by Harry and the Duchess of Sussex would be a private property outside London, with the Cotswolds among the areas being considered.

GB News reported that the search for a property in the Cotswolds could reach £8 million , which would add another major real estate commitment to a family that already has expenses from another home.

To the mansion they maintain in California and the possible new residence they are seeking in the United Kingdom , another property in Portugal is added. In this way, Harry and Meghan would expand their real estate presence in Europe while keeping their home in Montecito , which could translate into significant maintenance, tax, and management costs for each of these properties.

articles.title: Sydney Sweeney gets ahead of her birthday with a daring surprise that is already making waves
articles.standfirst: The actress has already started the countdown and chose a very particular way to do it.
articles.summary: The actress has already started the countdown and chose a very particular way to do it.
articles.body:
Although September 12 is still a few days away , the actress and model decided to get the festivities started early with a daring and sensual surprise she shared on social media.

It is “Birthday Boobs,” a new offering from SYRN that is part of the brand’s Romantic line.

The section features different lingerie pieces, including bras, matching sets and garters.

Birthday celebration in the kitchen?

In one of the posts, Sydney appeared in a kitchen wearing light blue sheer lingerie .

The image was accompanied by the message “ Birthday suits look a little different around here,” along with an announcement that quickly put a date on the calendar: the new collection will arrive on September 1 .

But the photograph was only a first look. The birthday concept was already present, although there was still more to come from Sydney’s take on the idea.

In another post, the actress swapped the blue set for a black semi-sheer one and appeared lying on a table while eating a cake .

The scene maintained the sensual tone of the previous images but added a detail much more closely tied to the celebration. Sydney captioned the photo “I really really love you...” and explained that the piece was designed by her and specially embroidered for the collection.

That way, the cake became part of a campaign built directly around the birthday theme, while the lingerie remained at the center of the photographs.
