articles.title: Inside Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton’s most personal vacation together
articles.standfirst: From New York to Hawaii, the couple have shared a string of increasingly personal trips.
articles.summary: From New York to Hawaii, the couple have shared a string of increasingly personal trips.
articles.body:
Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton have given fans a closer look at their relationship through a series of vacations and private getaways together in 2026.

The pair first sparked romance rumors in February after a meetup in Paris, before Hamilton appeared to confirm their relationship two months later by sharing a video of the couple driving his Ferrari F40 in Tokyo.

Since then, their time together has included trips across the United States and several family moments away from the spotlight.

Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton share summer together

In June, Kardashian and Hamilton were photographed spending time together in New York, including a bike ride around the city.

Their summer continued with a Fourth of July lake trip involving Kardashian’s children , where the group spent time outdoors, went hiking and jumped into the water.

Kardashian shared part of the getaway on social media with the caption: “summers at the lake with my favorite people”

The trip offered one of the clearest signs yet that Hamilton has been spending time not only with Kardashian , but also around her family.

Hawaii getaway gives fans a more personal look

The couple were later seen together in Hawaii in August, where their vacation included beach time and a sunset walk.

Photos from the trip showed Kardashian and Hamilton embracing by the water and posing together in a relaxed setting.

Hamilton kept his own caption simple, writing: “Outtakes.”

Kardashian also shared several posts from Hawaii, including one captioned: “Somewhere over the rainbow”

Another simply read: “Aloha.”

Their holidays have gradually offered more insight into a relationship that both have largely kept private.

Kardashian and Hamilton haven’t shared many detailed public comments about their romance, but their trips together have made the relationship increasingly visible.

From Paris and Tokyo to New York, the lake and Hawaii, the pair have spent much of 2026 finding time together around their demanding schedules.

The latest vacation photos may not reveal everything about their relationship, but they have provided the most personal look yet at how Kardashian and Hamilton spend their time together.

articles.title: Tim McGraw has an unexpected moment during his Cincinnati concert and this is how he reacted
articles.standfirst: What promised to be a spectacular night turned into a moment of uncertainty.
articles.summary: What promised to be a spectacular night turned into a moment of uncertainty.
articles.body:
Tim McGraw continues to prove that the stage still holds an important place in his life and, at 59, he maintains a busy schedule of performances throughout 2026. However, his recent concert in Cincinnati, held at Riverbend Music Center as part of his live tour across the United States , ended with a completely unexpected scene that quickly caught attention and that the singer himself decided to take with humor.

A night that started later than expected

To begin with, the concert did not start at the originally scheduled time. McGraw took the stage at around 9:40 p.m., approximately 40 minutes after the scheduled start time .

Once in front of the audience, the singer explained that travel issues and weather conditions had caused the delay. His arrival was accompanied by a brief apology and a phrase that summed up the moment: “I made it!”

With the initial inconvenience behind him, McGraw was finally able to focus on what had brought the crowd to Riverbend Music Center: his music . However, the delay would not be the only unexpected moment of the night.

articles.title: Katy Perry thinks her fans are insulting her and confronts them mid-concert
articles.standfirst: The singer experienced an unexpected misunderstanding amid the crowd’s chants and took a few seconds to figure out what was really happening.
articles.summary: The singer experienced an unexpected misunderstanding amid the crowd’s chants and took a few seconds to figure out what was really happening.
articles.body:
D uring her recent concert, Katy Perry found herself in one of those moments that could hardly have been part of the script . Amid the cheers, music and excitement of thousands of people, the singer began hearing a phrase that immediately caught her attention. At first, she tried to continue with the show, but it was repeated so many times that she eventually stopped.

Katy wanted to know what was going on.

The singer looked toward the crowd and, still surprised by what she thought she had heard, decided to ask them directly. “Are you calling me a ‘whore’?”

The question immediately sparked a reaction. But there was one detail Perry still did not understand: the crowd was not saying what she thought she had heard.

Rather than simply letting the moment pass, the singer kept trying to figure out what she was hearing from the audience. The chants continued as Perry searched for an explanation to a situation that, from the stage, seemed increasingly strange .

And then the real reason behind it all became clear.

What thousands of people were chanting was “¡Mucha ropa! ¡Mucha ropa!”, which translates to “A lot of clothes! A lot of clothes!”

The scene took place on August 25, 2026, during Katy Perry’s free concert at the Feria Nacional Potosina (FENAPO) in San Luis Potosí , Mexico. The performance drew more than 310,000 people, according to a figure reported by Billboard based on data from the organizers.

The singer still has several major commitments ahead following her performance in Mexico. Her next major appearance will be on Friday, September 25, 2026, when she joins the official entertainment lineup for Formula 1’s Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend at Baku Crystal Hall in Baku.

articles.title: Ester Expósito and Kylian Mbappé surprise with a romantic evening in Madrid
articles.standfirst: The actress and the footballer enjoyed a stroll and dinner in the capital, starring in one of their most natural and down-to-earth appearances to date.
articles.summary: The actress and the footballer enjoyed a stroll and dinner in the capital, starring in one of their most natural and down-to-earth appearances to date.
articles.body:
Madrid nightlife once again becomes the setting for one of those images that quickly sparks everyone's curiosity. Ester and Kylian have been seen sharing a walk and a dinner that have not gone unnoticed.

The evening began with a stroll through the capital before heading to a restaurant for dinner. The naturalness with which the two appeared is one of the details that has attracted the most attention.

The couple shared an evening together through the streets of Madrid

The actress and the footballer walked hand in hand, leaving behind the discretion that had until now marked their public appearances. The scene suggests that, at least in the public eye, the couple seem to feel increasingly comfortable sharing moments together.

After the walk, during which they were seen holding hands, they headed to a well-known Madrid restaurant for dinner. There they went in together and, several hours later, left the establishment in the same way: walking hand in hand and showing obvious complicity. An image that once again fuels speculation about a relationship that neither of them has publicly confirmed.

Far from grand gestures or carefully staged appearances, the encounter drew attention precisely because of its everyday air.

Ester Expósito rose to fame, and her love life has attracted as much attention as her work in television and film, something that is once again made clear by these new images. In the case of Kylian , his presence alongside the actress adds even more interest to a story that, for now, still leaves some questions unanswered.

However, for now, neither of them has publicly confirmed their relationship or put a label on the couple. Although their appearances together speak for themselves and show a closeness that seems to have grown stronger over time, it still remains for the two of them to confirm it.

Mbappé spoke out about Cristiano and Georgina's wedding

Between flashes and questions, Kylian Mbappé, forward for Real Madrid and a well-known admirer of Cristiano Ronaldo, reacted to the recent wedding of the Portuguese star and Georgina Rodríguez .

“The best for them,” he said without hesitation when asked about Cristiano and Georgina’s wedding. The conversation quickly took a turn when the interviewer wanted to steer the situation onto more personal ground: “Will you be next?” she asked him, referring to the possibility that the player might follow in Cristiano’s footsteps and walk down the aisle.

Faced with the question, Mbappé fell silent for a few seconds and preferred not to go into details. Without making any comment about it, he continued on his way and got into his SUV, leaving the answer up in the air.

Meanwhile, the anticipation surrounding Ester Expósito and Kylian Mbappé continues to grow. Between walks hand in hand, shared dinners, and knowing glances, the two seem to be experiencing this new chapter with ever greater confidence.

articles.title: Messi and Antonela Roccuzzo, to the rescue of Tini Stoessel: the millionaire fortune that became trapped in a family crisis
articles.standfirst: The Argentine singer is going through a major conflict with her father, Alejandro Stoessel, after an audit put under scrutiny the companies that managed the income from her career.
articles.summary: The Argentine singer is going through a major conflict with her father, Alejandro Stoessel, after an audit put under scrutiny the companies that managed the income from her career.
articles.body:
Lionel Messi and his wife, Antonela Roccuzzo , reportedly became the financial saviors of international star Tini Stoessel . The Argentine singer was immersed in a deep personal and financial crisis after discovering that her fortune, estimated at more than 70 million dollars , was completely outside her operational control, which sparked a conflict within her family circle.

The singer ordered an audit of the companies linked to her artistic activity, and it emerged that Antonela Roccuzz o may have introduced her to a legal and financial team to reorganize contracts, image rights, and royalties

The discovery that changed the course of Tini's fortune

The origin of the storm lies in a private audit requested by the music star herself. The review sought to determine how the companies related to her career were organized and found, according to her lawyers, that the artist was not listed as a shareholder nor did she have control over several companies that managed income derived from her music, image, and contracts.

The investigation came after Alejandro Stoessel , her father, stepped down from acting as her representative after 15 years at the helm of his daughter's career, and the financial blow cut deep on a personal level when it was confirmed that the absolute management of Tini 's fortune rested with her father.

The money in dispute would not be a single asset , but rather a network of royalties, tour revenue, image rights, and commercial contracts, in addition to transactions linked to properties and the so-called assets in Miami.

One of the situations that raised alarm bells reportedly emerged when Tini wanted to move forward with the purchase of a home in the United States and found limitations on the management of her own resources. Alejandro , who had managed her career for years, thus found himself at the center of a dispute that was no longer strictly a family matter and had moved into the corporate sphere.

In that scenario appears Antonela Roccuzzo , with whom Tini has a relationship, and it was Messi 's wife who would have facilitated contact with specialists accustomed to managing assets, commercial rights, and international agreements, while the Argentine captain would have backed the decision.

The intervention of Messi 's advisors meant a drastic 180-degree turn in the young Argentine star's defense strategy. The specialists structured a comprehensive financial rescue plan aimed at isolating her existing assets, renegotiating sponsorship contracts under new independent legal entities, and freezing any movement of funds not authorized by the singer. This high-level legal engineering maneuver immediately neutralized the risks of diversion and ensured that every dollar generated from now on goes to her personal accounts.

The news has generated a massive stir in the sports and entertainment media, as it exposes the bonds of deep loyalty that unite Argentine celebrities beyond public exposure and the cameras. This action also demonstrates the real influence that the Messi inner circle exerts as a shield for its intimate circle.

Although the family rupture seems definitive on the business front and the bridges have been burned, lawyers for both sides are seeking an orderly transition agreement that avoids a high-profile public trial of catastrophic proportions, protecting the singer's image for her upcoming releases.

Lionel Messi not only wins championships on the playing field, but he also knows how to win the most complex battles in the most demanding courtrooms in the world.

articles.title: Harry Styles brings Taylor Swift into the Madison Square Garden spotlight during his NYC residence
articles.summary: Taylor Swift is still on the minds of her exes, and this time, she made a surprise appearance in Harry Styles’ thoughts during his residency at Madison Square Garden. The iconic venue has been the stage for countless historic moments, and Harry is now living one of his own with 30 dates for his Together, Together tour. In the middle of one show, he recognized the arena as the home of the world champion Knicks, sending the crowd into a frenzy, but he couldn’t let the moment pass without adding that Madison Square Garden is now also a place where weddings happen. The crowd immediately lost it at the playful nod to the most talked-about wedding of the year between Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce. Harry simply let the moment unfold before continuing the concert and thanking everyone for being there that night.

articles.title: Who was Mbappé's kiss for after scoring at the Bernabéu? Ester Expósito was in the stands
articles.standfirst: The French star made it 3-0 and the cameras turned to her box. Expósito celebrated it in style.
articles.summary: The French star made it 3-0 and the cameras turned to her box. Expósito celebrated it in style.
articles.body:
The Santiago Bernabéu experienced an afternoon of football, goals, and a scene that quickly went beyond sports.

The team settled the match in barely half an hour of overwhelming play during the first half and ended up wrapping it up with a commanding 4-0.

Kylian Mbappé appeared on the scoresheet again with Real Madrid, but this time it was his celebration that ended up stealing much of the attention.

The kiss that no one let slip by

After scoring, Mbappé blew a kiss toward his box. The forward made a romantic dedication while celebrating his goal by blowing a kiss into the air as a nod to Ester .

The actress was at the stadium following the match, and it didn't take long for the cameras to capture her presence. The star of Elite celebrated the French forward's performance , while on the pitch Mbappé was making one of those gestures that immediately gets people talking.

Social media did the rest. For many viewers, it was inevitable to connect both moments: Ester following the match from the Bernabéu and Mbappé looking toward the stands during his celebration.

The scene also comes at a time when both seem to be showing themselves in public with increasing freshness and naturalness. This very Sunday, images of Mbappé and Ester Expósito walking hand in hand through Madrid came to light, once again fueling interest around a relationship that for months was marked by discretion and that they are now showing more and more.

The Bernabéu , however, added a different ingredient to the story. It was no longer about a dinner or a walk around the capital, but about Mbappé 's universe: a packed stadium, a goal, and millions of eyes following every move.

And among all those moments, there was one that ended up standing out above the rest: the Frenchman's kiss toward the stands . A gesture lasting only a few seconds that turned a sporting celebration into one of the most talked-about romantic scenes of the day.

articles.title: Billie Eilish's brother, Finneas, married his longtime girlfriend in a star-studded wedding.
articles.standfirst: Finneas O"Connell and his longtime girlfriend, Claudia Sulewski, are officially married. And yes, Billie Eilish was the officiant
articles.summary: Finneas O"Connell and his longtime girlfriend, Claudia Sulewski, are officially married. And yes, Billie Eilish was the officiant
articles.body:
Love is in the air and, finally, one of the most beloved and stable couples on the music scene has taken the big step. Finneas O’Connell , the brilliant producer and brother of Billie Eilish, got married this Saturday to his longtime girlfriend, actress and influencer Claudia Sulewski.

The couple chose the idyllic and exclusive San Ysidro Ranch in Santa Barbara, California, as the perfect setting for an outdoor wedding surrounded by greenery, to seal a love story that has been captivating their followers for eight years.

A guest list worthy of a red carpet

The celebration remained packed with stars from the couple's closest circle. Among the most prominent were Justin and Hailey Bieber, actors Kristen Bell and Dax Shepard, Nina Dobrev, Jason Sudeikis, content creator Emma Chamberlain, as well as Carter Gregory, Stassie Karanikolaou, and Rachel Sennott.

According to the first leaked images, the performer of "Birds of a Feather" officiated the couple's vows in a nature-surrounded setting. Billie was not alone; she attended accompanied by her boyfriend, actor Nat Wolff , sharing the front row with her parents, Maggie Baird and Patrick O’Connell.

Sulewski wore several Oscar de la Renta dresses during the weekend of celebrations. For the ceremony, she chose a spectacular strapless ball gown with a drop-waist bodice and an elegant scarf around her neck.

In an exclusive interview during her final fittings with Vogue magazine, the Shrinking actress confessed what she felt when she tried it on for the first time: "We were putting it on and I said, "this dress has something that simply calls for a minute of silence"". Even Billie Eilish herself joined the fittings by video call and couldn't contain her emotion when she saw her: "Oh my God, I can't believe it. You look like an angel", she told her now sister-in-law.

The couple's love story began in 2018, when they met through a dating app. Shortly after meeting, Finneas wrote the song “Claudia” , inspired by her. Sulewski was also the muse for the track “ Mona Lisa, Mona Lisa” , released in 2022, and starred in its music video.

Finneas and Sulewski got engaged in September 2025, during a mountain date. The couple then announced their engagement with the message “forever and ever 9.22”. Now, after eight years together, they are officially celebrating their marriage surrounded by family and friends from the entertainment world.

articles.title: Who is ColdheartedAC? The rapper now facing a federal indictment involving millions of dollars
articles.standfirst: His name began making headlines for a very different reason than the music he had been building over the past several years.
articles.summary: His name began making headlines for a very different reason than the music he had been building over the past several years.
articles.body:
Some stories can change direction in a matter of days, and ColdheartedAC’s is one of them. The rapper was arrested in California and is now facing a federal indictment that links him, along with two other people, to an alleged scheme involving stolen checks.

But before becoming the subject of a federal case, AC had a different story. He was an independent artist who had spent years trying to carve out a place for himself in rap , building his career under a name that is now appearing in headlines for entirely different reasons.

Who is behind ColdheartedAC?

Behind the stage name is Ada William Obayuwana, 31, a resident of Quartz Hill, California, a community north of Los Angeles . In music, he has used the names ColdheartedAC and AC, identities under which he developed his various projects.

His work falls within rap and hip-hop, and over the past several years, he released different singles on digital platforms. They include BUSY BODY, CORSA MODE, ChiAngeles and DESTINED .

At least until now, he was not one of the genre’s major commercial names. His path was more closely tied to the independent scene and to gradually building a larger audience.

That pursuit also took him beyond California. In 2022, he visited SiriusXM Studios in New York , showing that his musical activity extended beyond his online releases.

That path now appears to have taken an unexpected turn, as he faces a 25-count indictment filed by a federal grand jury alongside two other people .

According to prosecutors, the group allegedly participated in obtaining and attempting to cash checks that were reportedly stolen and belonged to the government, businesses and individuals.

The amount identified by authorities exceeds $8.1 million .

The investigation covers events that prosecutors say allegedly took place between April 2022 and December 2023.

For now, it remains unclear how the case will unfold. However, the investigation is ongoing and could bring additional developments in the coming days.

articles.title: Andree The Girl cause of death: What did the famous content creator die of at age 39?
articles.standfirst: The influencer left a prerecorded message that came to light just after losing her life
articles.summary: The influencer left a prerecorded message that came to light just after losing her life
articles.body:
Sad news reaches us this Monday, August 31, in the world of social media. And indeed, Andree Greig Baduoin, also known as “Andree The Girl,” died last Saturday the 22nd at a palliative care center located in the city of Lafayette, Louisiana, in the United States, at the age of 39.

She had amassed hundreds of thousands of followers across her profiles and was known for s haring her own experience with breast cancer, also leaving behind three children after her death. Some media outlets such as the NY Post reported all of this. The influencer's goal was clear: to raise awareness of the impact of the disease she had on people who fight against it. However, she left a posthumous message on social media to say goodbye to her community and those closest to her.

This was the message the influencer recorded before dying: “Don’t take your health for granted”

Andree had stage IV breast cancer and wanted to address her followers this way in a video lasting about six minutes, revealing her intentions to face the final stretch of her illness in a hospital, since, according to her, “she did not want to die at home.”

“I want this home to be a place full of life. I don’t want them to think about death when they are here, but I am not afraid of death. I will never be able to see my son get married, nor my daughter get married. I will never be able to meet my grandchildren. I will never be able to grow old alongside my husband, whom I love deeply,” she lamented.

Likewise, she thanked for having outlived her prognosis, since, as she reported , in June doctors told her she had only a few short weeks left to live. In closing, she left a phrase that emphasized to her followers that they should enjoy each day as if it were the last: “My greatest wish is that you do not take your health for granted or what you have in front of you. Enjoy the day ahead of you".

articles.title: Roses, candles, and a diamond ring: this was the proposal to Sylvester Stallone's daughter
articles.standfirst: Sophia Stallone has just taken the most important step in her relationship by receiving a spectacular marriage proposal.
articles.summary: Sophia Stallone has just taken the most important step in her relationship by receiving a spectacular marriage proposal.
articles.body:
M ichael Sheehan not only proposed to Sophia Stallon e with a spectacular diamond ring. He also achieved something that, according to the actor’s own daughters, was not exactly easy: overcoming the intimidating barrier of entering the Stallone family.

As they recounted on the family reality show, having Sylvester Stallone as a father could be intimidating, but Michael will soon officially become part of one of Hollywood's most famous families.

Sylvester Stallone's daughter is engaged!

Sophia Stallone, the 30-year-old producer, announced on her Instagram account this Friday, August 28 her engagement to her boyfriend. In a photo carousel, both look happy while sitting on the ground, surrounded by candles and white roses. Other photos show the two on a balcony, smiling at the camera while she poses with a luxurious diamond ring.

But perhaps the most significant thing was not the images but the phrase Sophia chose to accompany the photographs: “Forever with my best friend” (“Para siempre con mi mejor amigo”).

The news also had special significance because it involved Sophia , the eldest daughter of Sylvester Stallone and Jennifer Flavin.

The protagonist of Rocky, an actor recognized worldwide for his participation in the entertainment industry, has built over decades a public image associated with strength, action, and tough characters.

However, behind that Hollywood figure there is also a man deeply connected to his family. Stallone has been married to Jennifer Flavin since 1997, and although their relationship went through a major crisis in 2022, when Flavin filed for divorce after 25 years of marriage, the separation lasted only a few weeks. In September of that same year, both decided to reverse course and give their relationship another chance. Since then, the couple has remained together and has publicly shown a period of greater family closeness

When it came to his three daughters — Sophia, Sistine and Scarlet — his family side always held a different place. He always had a particularly close bond with the star of the engagement; in an interview given by his wife, Jennifer Flavin, she said that the two shared a very special connection and that Sophia was, among the three sisters, the one who resembled Stallone the most.

For this reason, seeing her committed today and taking one of the most important steps of her life has something more than special.

The family celebrated together.

The news didn’t take long to cause a stir. Sistine and Scarlet were among the first to congratulate the couple on social media, leaving messages full of excitement and affection.

Stallone also did not want to miss one of the most important moments in his daughter's life. The actor shared photographs of an intimate family celebration following the engagement and publicly expressed his excitement for the new stage of Sophia and Michael.

Sophia's mother also celebrated the news with a welcoming message for her future son-in-law.

For now, Sophia and Michael have not revealed when the wedding will be. But there is something that seems inevitable: when the big day arrives, Sylvester Stallone will have one of the most special roles of the entire celebration by accompanying his daughter down the aisle, an experience he will live for the first time.

articles.title: Carmen Electra sets social media on fire with daring photos from Berlin and leaves fans speechless
articles.standfirst: The model appears to be enjoying one of the best moments of her life.
articles.summary: The model appears to be enjoying one of the best moments of her life.
articles.body:
Carmen Electra once again made waves on Instagram . The actress and model shared a series of photographs taken during her stay in Berlin, quickly catching her followers’ attention with a post that mixed glamour, confidence, and a daring edge that did not go unnoticed.

Carmen Electra turned breakfast into a photoshoot

The post, accompanied by the message “breakfast in Berlin,” showed Carmen enjoying breakfast on a balcony, but the food quickly became almost an afterthought. Surrounded by fruit, desserts, and other details on the table, the actress took the opportunity to pose for the camera in blue and yellow lingerie .

From one photograph to the next, Carmen changed the energy of the shoot. In one of them, she appears enjoying a strawberry while looking directly into the lens , with a much flirtier attitude than that of a simple travel snapshot.

But one image took the conversation around the post even further. In it, Electra appears topless and uses a pair of pineapple slices to cover herself , taking the photograph into the provocative territory she knows so well.

From sensuality to her softer side

What makes the post even more interesting is that it came shortly after Carmen showed a completely different side of herself on social media.

Days earlier, the actress dedicated a post to her dogs for National Dog Day , sharing pictures with them and giving her followers a glimpse into a much more casual and affectionate part of her life.

That contrast says a lot about the way she currently uses her social media. Carmen does not seem to limit her content to a single image of herself: she can go from a sweet post with her pets to a much more daring photoshoot without having to choose between one side and the other .

Carmen Electra continues to write her own story

Behind these photographs, there is also a particularly interesting moment in her career. At 54, Electra continues to play with how she wants to present herself publicly and has spoken openly about not allowing age to determine what a woman can or cannot do .

Her return to Playboy , three decades after her first appearance in the magazine, once again put her at the center of the conversation this summer. Her social media activity and new professional projects add to that, signaling that her name continues to have a place in pop culture.

That is why the Berlin photographs feel like more than just another attention-grabbing post. They are part of a stage in which Carmen seems comfortable mixing glamour, sensuality, humor, and personal moments without worrying too much about fitting into a single version of herself.

And perhaps that is one of the reasons her posts continue to generate so much conversation: Carmen Electra does not seem to be trying to prove that she can still command attention; she simply continues to do it in her own way.

articles.title: Why will John Galliano no longer be at the Met Gala 2027? The controversy that changed the plans
articles.standfirst: The designer decided to put the Costume Institute’s planned exhibition about his career on hold after weeks of criticism over his past.
articles.summary: The designer decided to put the Costume Institute’s planned exhibition about his career on hold after weeks of criticism over his past.
articles.body:
John Galliano will no longer be the focus of the fashion exhibition accompanying the Met Gala 2027 , and behind this change is a controversy that began almost as soon as the Metropolitan Museum of Art announced the project.

The announcement that sparked controversy

The exhibition, titled “John Galliano: Horizons,” had been announced on July 31 and would have made the designer only the third living creator to receive this type of tribute. However, the decision reignited questions surrounding Galliano’s actions in 2011 , when he made antisemitic and racist comments that had a major impact on his career and ultimately led to his conviction on two hate-related offenses in Paris.

And although everything initially appeared to be moving forward normally, tensions surrounding the project increased in recent days. Some Met members and donors expressed concerns about the exhibition, while Julie Menin, president of the New York City Council , publicly called on the museum to reverse its decision. As a result, the controversy began to move beyond the fashion world and directly reached the institution and those responsible for organizing the event.

Galliano decided to step aside

Ultimately, it was Galliano himself who asked for the exhibition to be postponed in an effort to prevent the controversy from continuing to grow. In his message, the designer acknowledged the harm caused by his past words and said that an exhibition dedicated to his career should not become a distraction for the Costume Institute or a painful experience for people affected by his actions.

That is why Galliano will no longer be part of the Met Gala 2027 plans: the controversy lies in the tension between two sides of his history . On one hand, a career defined by enormous creative influence, from Dior to Maison Margiela; on the other, a past that returned to the center of the conversation when the Met decided to dedicate an exhibition to him. For now, the museum will have to rethink both the spring exhibition and the details surrounding the Met Gala 2027, with a new proposal expected to be announced later.

articles.title: Tupac Shakur: Jury finally confirms who is responsible for the rapper's murder in 1996
articles.standfirst: A former leader of the South Side Compton Crip ordered the shooting of the music's superstar
articles.summary: A former leader of the South Side Compton Crip ordered the shooting of the music's superstar
articles.body:
Nearly three decades after Tupac Shaku r was killed in a Las Vegas drive-by shooting, a jury has finally delivered a verdict in the case that became one of the most enduring mysteries in music and popular culture.

Duane “Keffe D” Davis, a former leader of the South Side Compton Crips, was found guilty of one count of murder with a deadly weapon for his role in the 1996 killing of Shakur. The 63-year-old Davis stood largely expressionless in a Las Vegas courtroom as the verdict was read. He later told the judge that he intended to appeal.

For Shakur's family, however, the verdict brought an emotional moment after years of uncertainty. Relatives held hands, hugged one another and cried as the long-running case finally reached its first conviction. Outside the courthouse, devoted Shakur fans also gathered, with some crying and others cheering after hearing the verdict.

A murder that defined an era

Shakur was only 25 years old when he was killed on Sept. 7, 1996. At the time, he was one of the biggest stars in hip-hop and one of the genre's most influential voices. His music had crossed well beyond rap, and his cultural influence continued to grow after his death.

He has sold more than 75 million records worldwide. His murder occurred during one of the most turbulent periods in hip-hop history, when tensions between the East Coast and West Coast rap scenes overlapped with longstanding gang rivalries involving the Bloods and Crips.

Shakur had been associated with the West Coast rap movement and Death Row Records , while his highly publicized feud with East Coast rapper The Notorious B.I.G. and Bad Boy Records became part of the larger narrative surrounding the era. But prosecutors argued that the events leading to Shakur's death were much more direct.

Prosecutors say Davis ordered the shooting

The prosecution's case did not depend on proving that Davis personally fired the weapon. Instead, prosecutors argued that Davis orchestrated the attack and supplied the gun that his nephew, Orlando Anderson , used during the shooting. Earlier on the day of Shakur's death, Anderson had been involved in a physical confrontation with Shakur and members of the rapper's entourage at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas.

According to prosecutors, the confrontation provided the motive for retaliation. They argued that Davis organized the response and was inside the white Cadillac from which the shots were fired later that night.

Shakur was riding in a BMW driven by Death Row Records founder Marion “Suge” Knight when a white Cadillac pulled alongside the vehicle. Gunfire erupted, striking Shakur multiple times. He died six days later at the age of 25.

Perhaps the most significant evidence presented to jurors came from Davis himself. For years, Davis had publicly discussed his alleged involvement in the events surrounding Shakur's death.

He acknowledged being inside the Cadillac during a secret 2008 police interview conducted as part of an investigation i nto the killing of The Notorious B.I.G., whose real name was Christopher Wallace.

Davis later provided additional details about his role in his 2019 memoir, Compton Street Legend, as well as in documentaries, podcasts and other media appearances. Those statements ultimately became crucial to the prosecution.

A protective agreement Davis had previously reached with authorities initially prevented criminal charges from being brought against him based on information from his police interview. But prosecutors argued that his later public statements and other actions had voided that protection. The court ultimately ruled that the 2008 interview could be used against him at trial.

articles.title: David and Victoria Beckham set social media abuzz after finding a vegetable with a strange shape in their garden
articles.standfirst: Both of them were left speechless
articles.summary: Both of them were left speechless
articles.body:
Rarely does a move by David and Victoria Beckham fail to make the news. And this time was going to be no exception. The high-profile couple has once again taken social media by storm after sharing a funny video in which they show the latest and peculiar discovery from their family vegetable garden: a pumpkin with such a strange and suggestive shape that it left the designer completely speechless.

In the video recorded by Victoria Beckham’s Instagram account, the former Real Madrid and Manchester United footballer can be seen proudly holding the vegetable harvested on his luxurious Cotswolds estate. T he conversation between them quickly went viral due to the inevitable double meanings prompted by the curves of the vegetable.

Victoria Beckham is amazed by the new vegetable from her garden: “There are so many things to say…”

“There’s a new vegetable... What is that, David?” Victoria asks, astonished. “It’s a squash” , David replies matter-of-factly. "I’d never seen something shaped like that before," admits the former Spice Girls member. "No?" her husband insists. "I don’t even know what to say. There are so many things to say... But, wow, look at that. Wow" , the businesswoman admits.

Although David insisted it was a pumpkin —ideal for practicing Halloween decorations—, many gardening experts and enthusiasts were quick to comment on platforms like Facebook that the plant actually appears to be an Italian variety known as "Tromboncino" zucchini (or trombetta) or a crookneck squash, famous precisely for growing in whimsically curved and elongated shapes.

This comical moment adds to David Beckham's already well-known passion for horticulture and country life , a hobby he regularly shares with his followers, showing everything from his greenhouses full of tomatoes and giant garlic to the fresh eggs he collects from his own chicken coop.

articles.title: Justin and Hailey Bieber starred in a tense moment at a wedding: what happened between them?
articles.standfirst: The images of the couple during Finneas O’Connell and Claudia Sulewski’s celebration drew attention because of their gestures and the distance they kept afterward
articles.summary: The images of the couple during Finneas O’Connell and Claudia Sulewski’s celebration drew attention because of their gestures and the distance they kept afterward
articles.body:
"J ustin Bieber and Hailey Bieber sparked controversy again over some photographs taken during a wedding held in California , where they were seen in the middle of an exchange that drew attention.

The scene shows the model gesturing while the singer speaks in front of her at the wedding held on Saturday, August 29 at San Ysidro Ranch . The celebration brought together numerous Hollywood figures and had Billie Eilish, sister of Finneas , as the officiant.

The images that sparked speculation

The released photos show Hailey with a very serious expression while talking to Justin and making several hand gestures. At a later moment, the two appear to go their separate ways, a sequence that sparked comments about the state of their relationship.

What drew even more attention was the contrast with the photos the singer himself posted on his Instagram during the celebration. The complete opposite is seen here: they appear to be enjoying the event, accompanied by hearts, which offered a much more affectionate image than the leaked ones.

Were they really arguing?

The body language of both was analyzed by an expert, who noted that some postures and gestures could convey tension. However, her reading does not allow us to state that there was a fight between Justin and Hailey or that the exchange was necessarily an argument.

The lack of context is precisely what turned the images into material for speculation. Additionally, a version circulated later by Cosmopolitan cited an anonymous source from DeuxMoi who denied that Justin and Hailey were fighting during the event.

The episode also comes just a few weeks before the couple’s eighth anniversary, who entered into a civil marriage in New York in September 2018 and later celebrated a religious ceremony in 2019 .

Finally, there is no confirmation that Justin and Hailey Bieber had a fight during the wedding, so any conclusion about a marital crisis remains in the realm of speculation.

articles.title: From Jean Grey to Calvin Klein: The Marvel actress turning heads with her bolder side
articles.standfirst: The star who brought Jean Grey to life has found a new way to capture attention after becoming the face of one of fashion’s most recognizable campaigns.
articles.summary: The star who brought Jean Grey to life has found a new way to capture attention after becoming the face of one of fashion’s most recognizable campaigns.
articles.body:
Sadie Sink has just revealed a completely different side from the one audiences have seen on screen . The 24-year-old actress, known worldwide for playing Max Mayfield in Stranger Things and for becoming Jean Grey within the Marvel universe , is now the new global face of Calvin Klein, starring in a campaign where denim and underwear take center stage.

A campaign that did not go unnoticed

The photographs show Sadie playing with different versions of the same style.

In the first look, she appears in light-wash jeans , a lace top that leaves part of her skin exposed and a black jacket, creating a bolder image.

The second features dark jeans and a low-cut black bra , taking the look in an even more daring direction.

For the third outfit, she pairs denim with a lightweight sweater featuring an opening at the neck and abdomen , maintaining the effortless aesthetic of the shoot.

Calvin Klein makes her one of its new global faces

The project marks the second chapter of the “Feel the Fit” fall campaign, photographed and directed by Aidan Zamiri .

Her image connects with a generation that has watched her grow from her earliest roles into an established figure with a presence in both film and fashion.

Sadie Sink still has several changes ahead

Her connection to Marvel will not end with her debut as Jean Grey in Spider-Man: Brand New Day . The actress is expected to reprise the character in Avengers: Secret Wars , scheduled for late 2027, while the studio continues moving forward with the development of the next official X-Men movie.

Outside that universe, Sink was also recently cast as the lead in The Marriage Plot, FX’s upcoming limited series directed by Hiro Murai.

articles.title: Sylvester Stallone faces the one fight Rocky never prepared him for as daughter Sophia gets engaged
articles.standfirst: Two photos taken 30 years apart reveal the vulnerable side of the father who always tried to protect her
articles.summary: Two photos taken 30 years apart reveal the vulnerable side of the father who always tried to protect her
articles.body:
R ocky Balboa was built to take punches. He could be knocked down, bloodied and pushed to the limit, but he always found the strength to stand again. Yet the photographs Sylvester Stallone shared as his eldest daughter Sophia turned 30 capture a challenge that has nothing to do with what happens inside a boxing ring.

In one image, a much younger Stallone holds Sophia in his arms when she was still a little girl . In another, the now 80-year-old actor embraces his adult daughter as she proudly raises her hand to show the engagement ring she received from longtime boyfriend Michael Sheehan.

Stallone posted the childhood photograph on Sophia’s birthday alongside other memories from her life. “30 years of making us proud,” he wrote. One day later, Sophia announced her engagement with romantic images surrounded by candles and white roses, writing, “Forever with my best friend ♾️.” Her father publicly celebrated the news and said the family was “so ecstatic” to welcome Michael.

Rocky could take any punch, but no one teaches a father how to let go

Stallone’s determination to protect his daughters has long been part of the family’s story. Sophia and her sisters have joked that bringing a boyfriend home could be nearly impossible because their father would intimidate dates with his stare and powerful handshake.

Jennifer Flavin once described the connection between Stallone and Sophia as especially close, saying they think alike, share the same gestures and calling Sophia “the love of his life.”

A father does not really lose his daughter when she becomes engaged, but his role inevitably begins to change. For 30 years, Stallone was the man who held Sophia , protected her and tried to keep danger away.

Now he must make room for the person she has chosen to stand beside her, care for her and build a life with her.

That is what makes the two photographs so powerful. The embrace remains almost the same, but the little girl Stallone once carried is now preparing to create a family of her own. Rocky taught millions that strength means getting back up after every punch.

Sophia’s engagement presents Stallone with a different kind of test: finding the strength to step back while his daughter moves forward.

articles.title: Do you know Cristiano Ronaldo's sister? Her reaction to the wedding with Georgina did not go unnoticed
articles.standfirst: "The union with Georgina Rodríguez was celebrated in an intimate civil ceremony, and the repercussions began. Katia Aveiro was among the first to react on social media to the marriage of Georgina and Cristiano.
articles.summary: "The union with Georgina Rodríguez was celebrated in an intimate civil ceremony, and the repercussions began. Katia Aveiro was among the first to react on social media to the marriage of Georgina and Cristiano.
articles.body:
The wedding announcement of Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez put an end to years of speculation about when they would take the big step. On August 11, 2026, the couple confirmed that they were already married by means of a photograph showing their hands with wedding rings.

Among the first reactions was the Portuguese star's sister, Katia Aveiro . Her message quickly drew attention for being extremely brief: two heart emojis.

Born as Liliana Cátia dos Santos Aveiro in Funchal, Madeira, on October 5, 1977, she is a Portuguese singer, businesswoman, and influencer, internationally known for being the older sister of footballer Cristiano Ronaldo . Over the years, she built her career as a singer, businesswoman, and social media figure.

Her connection to the world of show business began long before the Ronaldo family reached its international stature.

In 2005 she began a music career under the name Ronalda and later also participated in family-related projects, while maintaining a public presence closely linked to her brother's career

After an initial stage as a singer, during which she even collaborated with international producers such as RedOne, Katia Aveiro broadened her professional horizons and ventured into the business world after participating in "Survivors 2014" . In 2016, she entered the business world, leaving music and show business behind.

In 2018, she met the man who would become the love of her life . Katia Aveiro began a romantic relationship with Alexandre Bertolucci Jr ., whom she married in 2023. Together with him, she has built a large family following the birth of their two young children in Portugal, Dinis and Valentina, who are the driving force of her life along with her eldest son.

A brief reaction that became the center of attention

Ronaldo's sister was one of the first to react to the marriage to Georgina.

His response caught users' attention because it was extremely brief, but that simplicity is precisely what ended up drawing the followers' attention: he left two hearts, one black and one red, on the couple's post.

The reaction gained relevance precisely because of its simplicity. Faced with a family event of enormous international impact, Katia did not publish a long speech or explain her feelings: she simply left the two emojis on the post with which Ronaldo and Georgina announced that they were now husband and wife.

The wedding came exactly one year after the two announced their engagement. The footballer and the model had begun their relationship in 2016, when the footballer was playing for Real Madrid, and since then they went through their changes of country and club together while starting a family.

Those two hearts ended up serving as one of the first public signs of support from a close family member. A tiny gesture in a post that traveled the world, but enough to once again put the spotlight on one of the people who accompanied Cristiano Ronaldo long before he became one of football’s biggest stars

articles.title: From Hollywood to the subway: Adrien Brody appeared incognito in New York and surprised everyone
articles.standfirst: The actor was photographed alongside a friend while traveling like any other passenger and wearing a look designed to go unnoticed.
articles.summary: The actor was photographed alongside a friend while traveling like any other passenger and wearing a look designed to go unnoticed.
articles.body:
"A drien Brody surprised with an unusual appearance for a Hollywood star. The Oscar winner was seen on Monday, August 31, riding the New York subway with a friend, in a scene that showed him very close to his roots.

The 53-year-old actor tried to keep a low profile and chose an all-black look for his outing: a baseball cap, T-shirt, pants, and sneakers.

A city that is part of its history

Brody was born in Woodhaven , Queens, and grew up in Jackson Heights. New York is not simply the place where he was photographed this week: it is the city where he spent his childhood and adolescence and where he began to build his path as an actor.

Since he was a teenager, he was familiar with the city's public transportation; his train rides were part of his routine while he attended art school. He took around 4 trains on each trip, an experience that, according to what he said, ended up being much more meaningful than he had thought.

Something that drew attention is that the protagonist of The Pianist used public transportation to observe: on those rides he watched the people traveling with him, and from this he gathered detailed information about their gestures, finding there a source of inspiration.

The choice of public transportation takes on another meaning when Brody's relationship with the city is known. Long before becoming an international star, the subway was part of his routine.

Now, with no stage or cameras around, the actor found himself once again in one of the most everyday spaces of his youth. And although he tried to go unnoticed, he ended up starring in one of those images that show a much more down-to-earth side of a Hollywood. star.

His return to the subway feels almost like a postcard from his early years. The difference is that this time the young actor who used to commute to class was left far behind: the passenger trying to go unnoticed is now one of the great figures of American cinema.

articles.title: Cry for help? Kim Kardashian panics over North West's alarming lyrics after abrupt cancellation of tour
articles.standfirst: North’s horror-themed music video and deeply personal lyrics have prompted a new wave of reactions
articles.summary: North’s horror-themed music video and deeply personal lyrics have prompted a new wave of reactions
articles.body:
North West has spent much of 2026 building a music career on her own terms, but her latest release has prompted a very different kind of attention.

The 13-year-old daughter of Kim Kardashian and Kanye West has released a horror-inspired video for “Aishite,” a track from her debut EP N0rth4evr that leans heavily into themes of betrayal, isolation and emotional pressure.

The timing has intensified the reaction. The video arrived shortly after North’s planned co-headlining tour with rapper Molly Santana was canceled, adding to speculation about what the teenager may be expressing through her music.

One source told RadarOnline described the lyrics as “a blatant cry for help,” although there is no confirmed indication that North herself has characterized the song that way or that Kardashian has publicly said she believes her daughter is in crisis.

North West’s lyrics drawing attention

“Aishite,” which translates from Japanese as “love me,” is one of North ’s darker releases to date. In the song, she raps: “Ain’t nobody finna save me” and “Just love me, everyone betrays me.”

Elsewhere, North references distrust, being used by others and an inability to let people into her life. The Ty Akimoto directed video matches that tone, placing North inside eerie school hallways and an arcade while wearing a gothic-inspired outfit.

The imagery has sparked concern from some listeners online, but it also fits with the wider aesthetic North has embraced throughout her first major solo project.

N0rth4evr was released in May and incorporates elements of emo, trap, punk and metal, underscoring that darker themes are part of the sound and visual identity she has been developing.

Music remains serious ambition

The release also comes against a broader backdrop of North pushing deeper into entertainment. Her planned tour with Molly Santana was called off shortly before its scheduled start.

North later told followers: “I was really excited to go on tour with Molly Santana. Sadly it isn’t happening anymore, but I have something special for u guys. See ya soon.”

She has since made clear that music isn't simply a celebrity side project.

Asked recently about being advised to wait before starting a career, North said: “It’s like, nah, this is my hobby, this is what I like to do, this is what I wanna do with my life.”

She added: “I don’t like to rest a lot. I like to get stuff done.”

North has already built an unusual resume for someone her age, appearing on songs with her father, performing as Simba in a Lion King concert event and scoring a Billboard Hot 100 entry with “Talking/Once Again.”

That makes the reaction to “Aishite” more complicated than the lyrics alone.

The song is undeniably bleak in places, but North is also deliberately constructing an artistic identity centered on dramatic visuals, alternative music and provocative storytelling.

Concern may follow that evolution, particularly given her age and famous family. What remains unproven is whether the darkness of the song reflects anything beyond the music itself.

articles.title: Stepmom Era? Sydney Sweeney dotes on boyfriend Scooter Braun’s kids as relationship heats up
articles.standfirst: A new family outing offered the clearest glimpse yet of how closely the actress has become involved in his life
articles.summary: A new family outing offered the clearest glimpse yet of how closely the actress has become involved in his life
articles.body:
S ydney Sweeney ’s relationship with Scooter Braun is beginning to look increasingly serious, with the actress now appearing just as comfortable around his children as she does alongside him.

The 28-year-old Euphoria star was photographed in Los Angeles this week during a casual outing with Braun and his three children, Jagger, Levi and Hart.

The group stopped for smoothies before walking together, with Sweeney seen sharing an affectionate moment with one of Braun ’s sons.

It was a small gesture, but one that added another layer to a relationship that has steadily become more public since Sweeney and Braun were first linked in September 2025.

Braun, 45, shares Jagger, 11, Levi, 9, and Hart, 7, with his ex-wife Yael Cohen . The former couple married in 2014 and finalized their divorce in 2022.

Sweeney hasn't publicly described her role in Braun ’s family, and there is no indication she has taken on any formal parental position. Still, the latest outing has inevitably fueled speculation that their romance has moved into a more settled phase.

Sweeney appears increasingly comfortable

The actress kept the day low-key in a white T-shirt, flared jeans and sneakers, while Braun opted for a similarly casual look.

Sweeney appeared relaxed throughout the outing and was seen walking closely with Braun ’s children, reinforcing the impression that she has developed an easy relationship with them.

That family dynamic comes after a summer in which Sweeney and Braun have been seen together away from the usual Hollywood settings.

Earlier in August, the pair spent time in Spokane, Washington, where Sweeney helped communities affected by devastating wildfires.

“Spokane has always been home to me,” Sweeney wrote at the time. “It’s where I grew up, where my family still lives, and where so many of the people and places that shaped me are.

“Thousands of families have lost their homes, their belongings, and places of business, including members of my own family,” she added.

Romance unfolded away from public gaze

Despite regular sightings, Sweeney and Braun have said relatively little about their relationship publicly.

That has left moments such as this week’s outing to offer the clearest clues about how things are progressing.

Braun has largely stepped away from his former role as one of the entertainment industry’s most prominent talent managers, while Sweeney remains one of Hollywood’s busiest young stars.

The actress has also spoken openly about how important family remains to her. Years before her current relationship, she described the financial struggles her parents faced after the 2008 economic crash.

“My dad lost his job, and we lost our home,” she said.

Those experiences make the sight of Sweeney spending relaxed time with Braun ’s children more meaningful than a standard celebrity outing.

What is clear, however, is that Sweeney appears increasingly woven into Braun’s family life, which is a sign their relationship may be entering a much more serious chapter.

articles.title: Chris Brown immediately shuts down fan’s unusual request involving his wife

articles.body:
Chris Brown had an unexpected reaction when a fan at his concert made a very unusual request involving his own wife.

The man apparently wanted Brown to bring her onstage during his famously intimate “Take You Down” performance.

But as soon as Chris realized who she was, he immediately shut the idea down.

“That’s your girl? Nah, I ain’t gonna do that,” Brown said before learning they were actually married.

And that only made his answer even clearer.

When the fan told him, “That’s my wife,” Chris responded: “Hell nah,” leaving the crowd laughing at his disbelief.

articles.title: Carla Jeffery's cause of death: Disney star dies at just 33 years old
articles.standfirst: The Disney Channel actress, best known as Bree in the Zombies franchise, built a two-decade career across film, television and voice acting
articles.summary: The Disney Channel actress, best known as Bree in the Zombies franchise, built a two-decade career across film, television and voice acting
articles.body:
C arla Jeffery , the actress who became a familiar face to Disney Channel audiences through the Zombies franchise, has died at 33.

Jeffery died Sept. 1, 2026, according to a statement released the following day by Alexanders Talent Management, the agency that had represented her since she was a child.

Her death was confirmed through her official social media account, with her management team remembering an actress whose career had stretched across more than two decades.

Her cause of death has not been disclosed.

"It is with profound sadness that we share the passing of our beloved Carla Jeffrey ," Alexander wrote in the statement, "who passed away on September 1, 2026, at just 33 years old."

"For more than 20 years," the post continued, "we had the privilege of watching her grow into a beautiful, vibrant and incredibly talented woman whose radiant smile could light up any room.”

The announcement immediately prompted an outpouring of grief from people who worked with Jeffery throughout her career, particularly those who knew her from Disney's popular musical-comedy franchise.

Jeffery was born and raised in Houston and entered the entertainment business remarkably young. Her first major film role came at just 12, when she appeared alongside Mo'Nique in the 2006 comedy Phat Girlz.

Jeffery portrayed a younger version of Mo'Nique's character, giving her an early introduction to a professional acting career that would eventually take her across television, film and animation.

She subsequently appeared on a range of popular television programs, including iCarly, Shake It Up, Good Luck Charlie, Southland, Suburgatory and Crazy Ex-Girlfriend.

She also had a recurring role on HBO's Curb Your Enthusiasm, where she played Keysha Black, the daughter of Vivica A. Fox's character, Loretta Black.

But for an entire generation of Disney viewers, Jeffery will be most closely associated with Bree.

Jeffery found a lasting audience through Disney's Zombies franchise

Jeffery joined the Zombies universe in 2018, playing Bree, a cheerleader at Seabrook High and a close friend of Addison, the central character played by Meg Donnelly .

The original Disney Channel movie became the starting point for a larger franchise, with Jeffery returning for Zombies 2 in 2020 and Zombies 3 in 2022.

She later brought Bree back through voice work for Zombies: The Re-Animated Series, allowing her connection with the character to continue beyond the live-action films.

Her work as a voice actress represented another part of her career. Jeffery voiced Mania in Spider-Man in 2020 and continued providing the voice of Bree in the animated Zombies project.

The reaction from her former colleagues demonstrated the impact she had beyond her screen credits.

Chandler Kinney , who worked with Jeffery on Zombies, shared an emotional tribute after news of her death emerged.

"This doesn’t feel real," Kinney penned in an Instagram tribute featuring snapshots of their friendship on set. "The sweetest, most sparkly gal. you made every day better and brighter with your infectious positivity."

"I feel so grateful to have known your love. I’m going to miss laughing with you, and watching you break out your signature splits on any & every dance floor," the 26-year-old continued. "You’re a legend in my eyes, and your legacy of bringing joy and comfort to people everywhere will live on forever. I love you so much, CarlaBoo."

Other members of the Zombies cast also remembered Jeffery following the announcement. Milo Manheim and Trevor Tordjman were among those who shared tributes, with the cast reflecting on her personality and the energy she brought to the set.

Jeffery's management team similarly emphasized the qualities that went beyond her professional achievements.

"As Bree in Disney's hit Zombies franchise, Carla shared her joy, humor and bright spirit with audiences around the world," Alexander continued.

The statement also asked for privacy for Jeffery's family and friends as they "grieve this unimaginable loss."

Jeffery's death comes at a particularly young age, and the lack of an announced cause means there is currently no confirmed explanation for what led to her passing. Reports from ABC News, People, The Hollywood Reporter and other outlets have all confirmed her death while noting that her cause of death remains undisclosed.

Her career, however, leaves behind a substantial body of work for fans to remember.

From a first film role at 12 to becoming a recognizable Disney Channel performer, Jeffery spent more than 20 years working in entertainment. Her final legacy may be particularly strong among the viewers who grew up watching Zombies, but her résumé extended well beyond the franchise.

Her management team summed up that legacy in a message asking those mourning her to remember "her infectious smile, her laughter, her talent and the beautiful light she carried everywhere she went."

For fans and former colleagues, those memories will now stand alongside the characters and performances that made Carla Jeffery a familiar presence on screen.

articles.title: Julián Álvarez's Madrid refuge: the details of the house where he lives with his family
articles.standfirst: While his career at Atlético de Madrid keeps him in the spotlight, Julián Álvarez tries to keep much of his family life away from the cameras.
articles.summary: While his career at Atlético de Madrid keeps him in the spotlight, Julián Álvarez tries to keep much of his family life away from the cameras.
articles.body:
Far from the demands of soccer, stadiums, training sessions, and constant exposure, the Argentine forward finds calm alongside his wife and son in a bright and warm home.

Julián Álvarez and Emilia Ferrero built a family life in Madrid away from the constant exposure that accompanies the Atlético forward. Some images shared during a conversation between the footballer and Agustín Creevy made it possible to see, even if only partially, different corners of the home.

A house designed for family life

The property follows a contemporary and minimalist aesthetic, with spacious rooms, abundant natural light, and a constant connection between the interior spaces and the outdoors. The house features a predominance of neutral colors, simple lines, and integrated areas.

It doesn’t bet on luxury and excess, but rather on the care of each space and on design that makes the most of every setting. What stands out is how the spaces are distributed, and that is noticeable from the moment you enter.

The entrance leads to a double-height foyer that immediately reinforces the sense of spaciousness. The natural light and visual connection with other areas of the home make the space feel open and fluid. A bonsai adds a distinctive detail and serves as a focal point within the setting. The result maintains the understated aesthetic that predominates throughout the rest of the home.

Another of the most prominent areas is the kitchen . The space features high-capacity cabinetry, a central island, and equipment that meets the needs of a high-performance athlete.

The integration of the kitchen with the social areas also encourages a closer dynamic: while a meal is being prepared, the rest of the family can remain in the same environment. The layout thus seems to respond to a home designed for sharing and not only for moving between independent spaces.

Training and well-being, indoors

Well-being also has a place within Julián Álvarez 's home. The house has an area dedicated to physical activity and training, although it differs from the traditional image of a home gym.

Natural light and open spaces predominate in an environment designed so that physical activity forms part of the routine without altering the overall aesthetic of the home.

The space reflects an important part of the daily life of Julián and Emilia : personal care, consistency, and discipline, which are part of their habits, even away from the demands of professional soccer. Everything is arranged so that exercise is naturally incorporated into the family's daily life.

A private garden to escape the noise

The exterior serves as a natural extension of the home . The property features a garden surrounded by greenery, with spaces to relax and a swimming pool.

The large windows strengthen the connection between the garden and the interior spaces, making the outdoors part of the house’s everyday life. The layout allows for a sense of spaciousness without abandoning the search for privacy. The pool completes an area designed both for relaxation and for enjoying the outdoors.

Privacy, moreover, carries particular weight for the family. Before settling into their current home, Julián and Emilia lived in Boadilla del Monte, a period during which their exposure outside the field drew special attention. For that reason, the location of their current home is being kept private.

Despite the care taken to preserve their privacy, some details offer a glimpse into the place Julián Álvarez and his family chose for their everyday life. A bright, functional home open to the outdoors that, far from the stadiums and the spotlight, seems to serve a function as important as any refuge: to slow down and return to what is essential.

articles.title: Racy leaks and rumors involving Tom Brady: Part of Alix Earle's master plan to outdo Kim Kardashian
articles.standfirst: The influencer is putting family, romances and private life at the center of a much bigger fame play
articles.summary: The influencer is putting family, romances and private life at the center of a much bigger fame play
articles.body:
Alix Earle has already conquered the short-form internet. The bigger question now is whether she can make the leap from viral influencer to household-name celebrity, and her new Netflix reality series may be the most important test yet.

Earle Meets World, which premieres September 4, brings the 25-year-old’s family, relationships and personal drama into a format that looks strikingly familiar to anyone who watched Kim Kardashian turn reality television into a global business machine.

Earle has never hidden how badly she wanted attention early in her career. Speaking on Jamie Laing ’s Great Company podcast, she admitted: “I will do anything for a viral video on this app.”

That ambition helped fuel the “Get Ready With Me” videos that made her famous and created what became known as the “Alix Earle effect,” with products often enjoying a sudden surge in interest after she featured them.

Now the scale is changing. PR and reputation expert Olivia Bennett believes Earle is one of the strongest candidates yet to make the kind of crossover Kardashian achieved.

“Is Alix the new Kim Kardashian? I think she’s probably one of the strongest candidates we’ve seen,” Bennett said, as per the US Sun.

Turning family into part of the brand

The most obvious Kardashian comparison may be the decision to bring the wider family into the spotlight. The Netflix series features Earle’s father Thomas “TJ” Earle , her mother Alisa , stepmother Ashley Dupré , sister Ashtin and younger half-siblings.

TJ also helps manage his daughter’s career, earning the family nickname “Dad-enger,” an obvious echo of Kris Jenner ’s famous “momager” role.

Earle told TV Insider that not everyone immediately embraced the idea of filming.

“I think it took a bit for everyone to fully get on board,” she said. “But I think we have had so many other people talk about our family and have that story out there that we wanted to show it and do it for ourselves.

“We were like, ‘You know what? We’re a pretty entertaining crew. There’s always something going on.’”

Relationships and feuds now part of the story

Earle ’s dating history is also likely to keep viewers watching. She has previously dated baseball player Tyler Wade and NFL receiver Braxton Berrios and has more recently been linked with other high-profile athletes.

In the new show, she jokes: “I don’t have a type, it’s personality. Maybe athletes.”

The show also addresses her fallout with podcast host Alex Cooper , with Earle insisting there is more to the story.

“She’s trying to paint it as I’m just like this crazy lunatic who is, like, hating her for no reason,” she says. “There’s a reason.”

Earle has also spoken publicly about an explicit photograph being shared without her consent, calling the experience “an invasion of privacy.”

That willingness to expose more uncomfortable parts of her life could be crucial to making the show work.

Netflix could give Earle new audience

Bennett argues that the real value of Netflix isn't making Earle famous, but broadening who knows her.

“There’s a difference between being incredibly famous online and becoming somebody your mum, your aunt and people who have never opened TikTok would recognize,” she said.

The risk is losing control. TikTok allows Earle to choose every clip. Reality television does not. But if Earle Meets World succeeds, the reward could be significant.

Earle is already moving beyond endorsements, launching skincare brand Reale Actives and investing in other businesses. That's where the Kardashian comparison becomes most meaningful.

articles.title: Diddy’s prison release date moves up again as he gets 15 days closer to freedom
articles.standfirst: Federal records now list February 5, 2028, but the music mogul’s constantly changing countdown may not be settled yet
articles.summary: Federal records now list February 5, 2028, but the music mogul’s constantly changing countdown may not be settled yet
articles.body:
T he calendar keeps moving for Sean “Diddy” Combs. The music mogul’s projected prison release date has been changed once again, bringing him more than two weeks closer to freedom.

Federal Bureau of Prisons records now list February 5, 2028, as the date Combs is expected to leave FCI Fort Dix in New Jersey. His previous release date was February 20, meaning the latest adjustment removes exactly 15 days from his time behind bars.

No official explanation has been provided for the change. Federal release dates are projections and can move because of sentence calculations, earned credits, participation in prison programs or disciplinary decisions. Combs’ date has already changed several times, so February 5 is not necessarily final.

Diddy’s prison timeline keeps changing

The latest adjustment follows a turbulent period at Fort Dix. Combs was reportedly involved in a fight with another inmate and spent a brief period in solitary confinement. Around that time, his projected release date moved from January 24 to February 20. The Bureau of Prisons has not said whether the altercation or any disciplinary action was connected to those changes.

Combs was sentenced in October 2025 to 50 months in federal prison after a jury convicted him on two counts of transporting individuals across state lines for prostitution. The same jury acquitted him of the more serious racketeering conspiracy and sex-trafficking charges. He received credit for time already served following his September 2024 arrest.

For now, February 5, 2028, is the closest thing Combs has to a finish line. But after watching that date move forward, backward and forward again, even that countdown should be written in pencil.

articles.title: Stephen A. Smith claims former ESPN star wanted Molly Qerim’s ‘First Take’ job then realizes he may have been catfished
articles.standfirst: Champion checked the receipts in real time and left Smith confronting the possibility that someone had impersonated his former ESPN colleague
articles.summary: Champion checked the receipts in real time and left Smith confronting the possibility that someone had impersonated his former ESPN colleague
articles.body:
Stephen A. Smith thought he had caught Cari Champion admitting something she did not want made public. By the time she finished checking her phone, the accusation had turned back on him.

During Smith’s appearance on Flagrant and Funny , the podcast hosted by Champion and Jemele Hill, the ESPN star claimed Champion contacted him after Molly Qerim left First Take and expressed interest in returning to her former seat.

Champion’s reaction was immediate. She denied contacting Smith about the opening and appeared genuinely stunned that he believed the conversation had occurred.

“Where and when?” she demanded as Hill reacted with similar disbelief.

Smith initially stood by his version of events. He recalled receiving a message that he believed came from Champion and repeated what he remembered it saying: “We need to talk. I need to be back in that seat.”

Cari Champion asks Stephen A. Smith for the receipts

Champion began reviewing her messages to Smith from the previous year in real time. She said there was nothing about Qerim, First Take or an attempt to return to ESPN.

The confusion deepened when Smith and Champion acknowledged that both had changed their phone numbers during the previous 12 months. That raised the possibility that Smith had received a message from someone using a number he incorrectly believed belonged to Champion.

Faced with her emphatic denial and the missing message history, Smith finally backed away from the allegation.

“Then it was somebody who pretended to be her,” he conceded.

The exchange did not reveal who allegedly sent the message, how that person obtained Smith’s number or whether Smith still possessed the original text. It also did not independently establish that an impersonator was responsible. What it did establish was that Champion categorically denied requesting Qerim’s position and challenged Smith to produce evidence.

What initially sounded like an inside revelation about ESPN’s most prominent debate show instead became a bizarre possible catfishing story involving two of the network’s most recognizable former colleagues.
