Cari Champion asks Stephen A. Smith for the receipts
Champion began reviewing her messages to Smith from the previous year in real time. She said there was nothing about Qerim, First Take or an attempt to return to ESPN.

The confusion deepened when Smith and Champion acknowledged that both had changed their phone numbers during the previous 12 months. That raised the possibility that Smith had received a message from someone using a number he incorrectly believed belonged to Champion.
Faced with her emphatic denial and the missing message history, Smith finally backed away from the allegation.
“Then it was somebody who pretended to be her,” he conceded.

The exchange did not reveal who allegedly sent the message, how that person obtained Smith’s number or whether Smith still possessed the original text. It also did not independently establish that an impersonator was responsible. What it did establish was that Champion categorically denied requesting Qerim’s position and challenged Smith to produce evidence.

What initially sounded like an inside revelation about ESPN’s most prominent debate show instead became a bizarre possible catfishing story involving two of the network’s most recognizable former colleagues.

articles.title: Beyoncé surprises fans by putting a nearly $1,000 item up for sale and sparks criticism
articles.standfirst: Is it worth it?
articles.summary: The singer turned 45 on a meaningful date, but a curious item from her online store ended up stealing part of the spotlight.
articles.body:
Today, September 4, is Beyoncé’s birthday . The singer turns 45 on a date that carries even greater significance for her career, as it also marks the 20th anniversary of B’Day , her second studio album, which cemented a pivotal era in her career. However, amid such a special day, an item that appeared in her online store began to attract attention and left fans asking one question:

What exactly is she selling?

The product is called the Bey Keeper Collector’s Box , and it is far from an ordinary box. Its design is inspired by the structures beekeepers use to house and manage bee colonies.

But what would fans use it for? The answer lies in its purpose: it was created to store and display the singer’s vinyl collection. It is also an extremely limited edition, with only 500 units available, making it even more appealing to collectors .

The design also features a series of materials and finishes that add to the piece. It is handcrafted from solid pine wood, with a dark green velvet-lined interior, a faux leather gator-finish strap, gold-tone hardware, and custom engraved details. It measures 45 centimeters long by 35 centimeters wide .

This is where the story takes a completely different turn.

The product description makes that clear with a phrase that is difficult to overlook: “Vinyls Not Included.” In other words, anyone who pays $948.01 for the piece will not receive any of Beyoncé’s records inside it.

And that was precisely the detail that sparked criticism on social media. While some defended the purchase because it is a collectible item whose value goes beyond what it holds , others found it difficult to justify such a high price for an object that, at least at first glance, was simply an empty box.

articles.title: Alix Earle reveals the message she wrote to Alex Cooper and her words are devastating
articles.standfirst: The influencer does not seem very happy with the professional relationship she had with the podcast host.
articles.summary: The influencer does not seem very happy with the professional relationship she had with the podcast host.
articles.body:
In 2023, Alix Earle was still taking her first steps toward building her career when an opportunity came along that was difficult to overlook. Alex Cooper had just launched Unwell , her own podcast network, and decided to bring Alix on board as part of the new project. That led to Hot Mess with Alix Earle , a space that not only allowed her to develop her own voice but also gave her the chance to work closely with a woman she admired and could learn from.

However, what initially looked like a dream come true for Alix began to look different as time went on. Comments about their relationship gradually emerged, and eventually, in 2025, came the moment that changed everything: Hot Mess was no longer supported by Unwell , and Alix said she did not receive the news directly from Cooper or her team, but instead found out through the media.

For months, Alix chose to stay out of the conflict and did not respond publicly. Even when Alex spoke about her in April 2026 and accused her of creating “fake drama,” the influencer decided to remain silent and avoid a direct confrontation.

But as rumors about her relationship with Cooper continued to grow, Alix finally decided to speak out. During the finale of Earle Meets World, she revealed a message she had written to Cooper that perhaps explains better than any public comment where their relationship had been left.

In the message, Alix described Cooper as “manipulative and toxic,” questioned the way she conducted business, and claimed that Alex put money above morals. She also said Cooper had taken advantage of her when she was young and still did not know how the industry worked.

But why did she decide to remain silent for so long?

Earle also explained why she had chosen to stay quiet in 2025. According to her account, she was afraid to confront Cooper and recalled a phrase the podcast host allegedly told her: “You don’t want to go to war with me.”

So, in the end, with these statements, Earle seems to have finally closed a chapter that had remained unresolved for months.

articles.title: Famous comedian moves fans after revealing family tragedy he kept private for months
articles.standfirst: An unexpected announcement left his followers stunned.
articles.summary: An unexpected announcement left his followers stunned.
articles.body:
R ussell Howard, known for his work on Mock the Week and Russell Howard’s Good News , has left many of his followers stunned after deciding to share an incredibly difficult moment with them.

The 46-year-old British comedian revealed that he and his wife, Cerys Morgan , had been expecting their second child, a piece of news they had both decided to keep private until an unexpected situation changed everything.

Howard revealed that his son died just hours after being born. The couple had chosen to go through the entire process privately and stay away from the spotlight as they tried to cope with a loss the comedian himself described as “the most devastating moment of our lives.”

During those days, Russell and Cerys found support in the hospital staff, whom the comedian thanked for the compassion, kindness and humanity they showed them.

Felix’s memory will now help other families

How will they make this possible?

After what happened, Russell and Cerys found a way to keep their son’s memory alive by creating The Felix Foundation, an organization that will work to ensure families do not have to face one of the most difficult moments of their lives alone . Its work will cover situations including miscarriage, premature birth, stillbirth and neonatal death, while also involving partnerships with specialist facilities, training programs and other resources designed to support those facing this kind of grief.

And now, the first major step toward bringing this project to life already has a date.

Russell Howard will bring together top comedians in Felix’s memory

On February 8, 2027 , Russell Howard will host a comedy gala at London’s O2 to raise funds for The Felix Foundation. The evening will feature names including Michael McIntyre, Jimmy Carr, Aisling Bea, Guz Khan, Greg Davies, Mo Gilligan, Michelle Wolf and John Bishop.

articles.title: From Hannah Montana, through Miley Cyrus, and now she is changing her stage name again
articles.standfirst: The artist decides to call herself simply Miley, drops Cyrus, and her father reacts to it
articles.summary: The artist decides to call herself simply Miley, drops Cyrus, and her father reacts to it
articles.body:
M iley Cyrus unexpectedly announced her new album , titled "Bass Persuades", which will be released on September 18. She will present it in two concerts at the Hollywood Bowl during the month of October, marking her return to the stage after years away from it. But this new announcement has revealed a curious detail that has not gone unnoticed. Her name. More specifically. Her new name .

Disney star has dropped her last name, to simply go by Miley. And she has done so for a family reason. One of the first to react to this move by the artist was precisely her father, Billy Ray Cyrus, who responded to it on his social media.

"Family means more than ever now. I always called my little Miley. Simply... Miley. Just like I always called my little son Braison," the country artist began in his text. "I bet you didn't know... I was simply Cyrus before Achy Breaky Heart came out in '92. All my clothes and T-shirts only said: "Cyrus gave it his all" with an image of a POWMIA flag and the phrase: "We won't forget you" , her father added.

In fact, her father reacted naturally to the matter. "Yesterday I told Miley that I thought it was fine for her to use her first name. I mentioned Dolly and Cher. I think about it more and more... Elvis... Prince... and so on. It’s a natural progression for an iconic superstar legend" .

Billy Ray sidestepped any controversy over the matter in question, making it clear that there is no tension between them, since years ago they were estranged due to his tense separation from Tish, the singer's mother, in 2022 and the accumulated family dynamics dating back to the Hannah Montana era.

The first name change: from childhood to youth

The transition from Hannah Montana to Miley Cyrus was a profound and rebellious transformation through which the artist left behind her Disney Channel era to build her own musical and personal identity . A radical change. Her moment. from childhood to youth. New rhythms. New goals.

Miley starred in the hit Disney Channel series for four seasons between 2006 and 2011 . Although the character used her real name and blended reality with fiction as a marketing strategy, the singer felt that her childish image had been imposed on her and that she needed to get to know herself. Hence that first change. And now comes the next step in that phase, which the artist sees as referring to her evolution in life.
